Note:
This is the Hutber version of the brilliant FTC Competitive 40k Map Base 10th. Only Grand Tournament play is supported. Everything is taken from him and I just wanted to see some new features. 

Please raise issues at https://github.com/hutber/hutber-tts/issues.
Or file issues with the original base map project: https://github.com/ThePants999/tts-comp-ftc-base-lua-scripts

Instructions can be found in the Notebook.

If any of the maps need updating please let me know via the github issues.


Join the TTS 40K Discord server: https://discord.gg/Drpzcwwmm6

0.title: New Features
0.body:
New Features Exaplined:


Injection Detection Tool:
• The code checks every 15 seconds to see if any objects currently on the board have been 'infected'
• If you have an infected object you will see a large red error wanring you and
a 'Virus' will appear in the center of the battle field
Interaction Changes
• Some changes have been made with how you will use the map base:
• You will need to click `Confirm for gaming` to you see secondaries and other game related features.

Selection Tool:
• It will now highlight for everybody in the game which models have been selcted.
• I use this when I want to show guys 'ok these will shot'
• The Selection tool is debatable if you need it. Most use tab to do this, but not me. It just felt more natural to highlight the unit.

Lethal Hits Buttons
• The 'Lethal hits' button is a new feature and its still a little ropey
• It will need more work to be a little smarted
• I will add sustained and susatined+letahsl etoo.

Vortex:
• Vortex is there, but as explained in my reddit post, I do not believe we need
from a performance perspective. It was the injected code is what was causing the game to be laggy. But its a beautiful tool (user hutber)

1.title: Gaming instructions
1.body:
SETTING UP THE GAME

When loading or connecting choose your seat in the shown menu.

Additive load a terrain save file for FTC Gaming Template v2.0 or above, the map and the mat background will be placed. Confirm it or remove if you want to change with another map. In the table control menu (on one of the table legs) there is a button to erase all but the table in the gaming area, in case you wrongly confirmed. This button erases already placed armies and other things too.

You can then import your army. If you import one made with the FTC Army Builder v2.0 or above (you can find it in the workshop) just additive load the save file and use the buttons to place the army on your side or remove it if you want to change it. Make sure that nobody loads a new army until the previous one is placed or deleted to prevent physics spaz.

Use the menu on the top of the gaming mat to place the chosen deployment areas and objectives for the chosen mission. If terrain is interfering with the deployment zones or objectives, you can use the + and - buttons to raise or lower them.


STARTING THE GAME

Deploy the armies as per the rules for the mission you are playing. Select the starting player with the toggle button, and when you are ready, start the game with the clearly marked button. Turns will be automatically taken in the chosen order, and the battle-forged CP will be automatically added each turn.

During the game you can re-show and re-hide the selected deployment zones by clicking on the corresponding buttons placed near the top of battle mat. There are also buttons to show table quarters, Engage zones, Strategic Reserves zones, and to show 3" and 6" distances from the center. You also can use buttons on the upper left to go easily to dice roller and back (select a model first to go back to it)

You can save and load your game at any point of the game or setup. When loading a save file of a started game, the players will be automatically placed in the seats they had when they started to play.


PLAYING THE GAME

Objective markers have multiple states. The default state (1) provides a mat showing both the marker and the control radius. State 2 shows you the marker itself. State 3 provides a 3" cylinder so you can easily check range. States 4 and 5 are the same as state 1 but in red and blue, useful for highlighting control or sticky control.

To roll dice simply drop them into the small cardboard box, it will roll them and place them in order on the rolling mat. The rolling mat will display the results along with the total dice rolled. Also present are buttons to spawn dice of 4 colors, to select them and to delete them. Near each row of dice are present buttons to delete or re-roll dice rows, left click affects only that row, right click affects that row plus all the lower (-). If you click the " - / + " button, the next right click will delete/re-roll that row plus all the higher dice instead. Use the description of the small box to change your preferences and the behavior of the tool. You can also switch between re-rolling and selecting. There's also buttons to roll dice showing you what order they were rolled in, useful for Feel No Pain rolls, and a button to mark whatever die is currently on the mat as the die to spawn copies of, useful if you've got a custom (e.g. faction) die you'd like to use.

You can find a set of useful generic tokens at the head of the table, copy them and use them as you see fit.

Activation tokens: an interactive token can be placed near each unit to keep track of which ones have acted in each phase. Green means that the unit has to act; red that it has already acted. To change the state, just click on the coloured button. All the tokens are reset automatically at each phase/turn change. You can manually reset them by clicking on any "Reset Activation tokens" button. With the token selected, you can use the Numpad1 and Numpad2 to lower/raise the position of the button.

Wound trackers: an interactive token can be placed near each model to keep track of its remaining wounds. To reduce the number left click on the button, to increase it right click. With the token selected you can use the Numpad1 and Numpad2 to lower/raise the position of the button.

The counters are self explanatory; the player's turn and the battle round ones are automatic, you don't need to update them manually. The victory ones will reflect the value of the score sheet if you use it.

If you want to use the chess clock, you can pass the time to your opponent by clicking on the time shown on the top-right of the UI. Alternatively, you can press keypad 7 if you're red, or 9 if you're blue.


MISCELLANEOUS

The battle mat is a modified "Flex Table" (by MrStump) with fixed dimensions. You can change the background of the mat by clicking on the white button on one of the legs and paste the URL of the image.

You can store URLs in memory by adding them individually so you can recall them easily if you want to make a local version with stored images. An improvement in version 2 is that you now only need to provide the image of the battle mat itself, you don’t need to edit a massive image containing the felt part. For best results, use an image with the correct ratio!

Report any bugs at https://github.com/hutber/tts-map-base/issues

2.title: 10th edition missions
2.body:
The 10th edition mission packs, Leviathan and Pariah Nexus, are fully supported.

Above the scoreboard, you'll find a pack selector and decks for deployment, mission rules and primary missions. If you already know which ones you want, you can just search the decks for the right cards, or you can use the Mission Selection options on the right to either randomise or choose from one of GW's recommended presets.

When you've picked a colour, you'll find a set of cards in your hand - the Fixed Secondary Missions, and two Tactical Missions cards. When you get to the Select Secondary Missions mission step, choose the two cards you want and flip those cards in your hand face down with the F key, then press Lock In Secondaries. Once both players have done that, the selected cards will be revealed.

Once you start the game, fixed missions will be locked in, while tactical missions will be cleared ready to draw some real ones. Whenever you need to draw a card, press the arrow button next to the deck. You can use the arrow button next to a drawn card to recycle it (e.g. because the card tells you to), or the X button to discard it (e.g. because you've completed it, or used the New Orders stratagem).

At the end of the third battle round, press Prepare Secrets, and the Secret Mission cards (if playing Pariah Nexus) or a random selection of Gambit cards (if playing Leviathan) will be placed into your hand. Choose one and flip it to select it, then press Lock In Secret. Once both players have done so, you can reveal the choices by flipping them.

3.title: Terrain instructions
3.body:
TERRAIN BUILDER INSTRUCTIONS


This tool is made to prepare terrain for the Forty Thousand Collection Template v2.0 or later versions but works with other templates too if the gaming mat position is 0,0,0 .


PREPARING THE TERRAIN:

Prepare your terrain as you like, be sure that all elements are tolally inside the gaming mat, no parts have to be outside.

The battlemat is a modified "Flex Table" (by MrStump) with fixed dimensions. You can change the mat background by clicking on the white button on one of the legs and paste the URL of the image.
You can store some URL in memory by adding them individually so you can recall them easily.
You dont need anymore to edit the mat image to fit the bigger dimension of the table, only the gaming area will change, not the entire table.
There are some preset mats, so you already have something to work with, but feel free to use any URL that you like.

When the terrain and the mat are ready, press the "EXTRACT TERRAIN" button present in the table control menu and confirm.
You will then have a map only with the terrain features and a blue brick that is a service token used to store the URL of the mat image. This brick is invisible and not interactable but it has its own menu that will display when loading the terrain.

All outside the gaming mat will be deleted.

Save then the map in another local savefile or upload it to the workshop.

The "DELETE TERRAIN" button deletes all but the table inside the gaming area, useful for starting from scratch.

LOADING THE TERRAIN:

Open the gaming template then make an ADDITIVE LOAD of the terrain map saved or present in the workshop.

The terrain will be put on the gaming mat and the mat image will change automatically.
In case it doesnt works you can copy the URL and apply it manually using the "Flex Table" menu.

When done you can erease the menu showing the saved URL by clicking the proper button. It's NOT reversible.

Have fun!

LuaScript:
--"LuaScript":\s*"(?:\\.|[^\\"])*"

--[[ Lua code. See documentation: https://api.tabletopsimulator.com/ --]]

-- BEGIN include: includes/counterAccess.lua
-- Polymorphic counter access. Works for both TTS built-in Counter objects and
-- the token "Clean Counters" (which expose getValue/increment/etc. via
-- includes/cleanCounter.lua). Lets caller code treat either kind the same way,
-- so swapping a counter's type does not require touching every call site.

function counterValue(obj)
    if not obj then return 0 end
    if obj.Counter then return obj.Counter.getValue() end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj.call("getValue") end)
    if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
    return 0
end

function counterSetValue(obj, v)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.setValue(v)
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("setValue", v) end)
    end
end

function counterIncrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.increment()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("increment") end)
    end
end

function counterDecrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.decrement()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("decrement") end)
    end
end
-- END include: includes/counterAccess.lua
-- BEGIN include: includes/diceStatsPanel.lua
-- Dice Stats Panel
-- Opened from the on-table Control Panel ("Dice Stats" button). Shows, for the
-- viewing player only, the per-face breakdown (count of each 1-6) and mean for
-- both sides, an overall "who is rolling better" balance line, and a head-to-head
-- vs the opposition.
--
-- Data comes from each roller's getRollAnalytics() (the same numbers sent to
-- apistats.hutber.com), which now also returns faceCounts {n1..n6}.
--
-- Pulled into global.ttslua via `-- @include includes/diceStatsPanel.lua`.
-- Roller GUID vars (redCustomDiceRoller_GUID / blueCustomDiceRoller_GUID) are
-- defined in global.ttslua, so they are referenced directly here.

function getDiceStatsAnalytics(rollerGuid)
    if not rollerGuid then return nil end
    local roller = getObjectFromGUID(rollerGuid)
    if not roller then return nil end
    local ok, analytics = pcall(function() return roller.call("getRollAnalytics") end)
    if not ok or type(analytics) ~= "table" then return nil end
    return analytics
end

-- Builds the multi-line per-side column (face counts + totals + mean).
function formatDiceStatsColumn(analytics)
    if not analytics then
        return "Roller not found."
    end
    local total = tonumber(analytics.totalRolls) or 0
    if total == 0 then
        return "No rolls yet."
    end

    local counts = analytics.faceCounts or {}
    local lines = {}
    for face = 1, 6 do
        local count = tonumber(counts[face]) or 0
        local pct = (count / total) * 100
        table.insert(lines, string.format("%d :   x%d     (%.1f%%)", face, count, pct))
    end
    table.insert(lines, " ")
    table.insert(lines, string.format("Rolls:  %d", total))
    table.insert(lines, string.format("Mean:  %.2f   (exp 3.50)", tonumber(analytics.average) or 0))
    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function buildDiceStatsBalanceLine(red, blue)
    local redRolls = red and (tonumber(red.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    local blueRolls = blue and (tonumber(blue.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    if redRolls == 0 and blueRolls == 0 then
        return "No dice rolled yet - roll some dice to see who the dice gods favour."
    end

    local redAvg = red and (tonumber(red.average) or 0) or 0
    local blueAvg = blue and (tonumber(blue.average) or 0) or 0
    local diff = redAvg - blueAvg
    if math.abs(diff) < 0.05 then
        return string.format("Dead even - both sides averaging about %.2f.", (redAvg + blueAvg) / 2)
    elseif diff > 0 then
        return string.format("Red is rolling hotter - mean %.2f vs %.2f  (+%.2f)", redAvg, blueAvg, diff)
    else
        return string.format("Blue is rolling hotter - mean %.2f vs %.2f  (+%.2f)", blueAvg, redAvg, -diff)
    end
end

function buildDiceStatsHeadToHead(red, blue, viewerSide)
    local redRolls = red and (tonumber(red.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    local blueRolls = blue and (tonumber(blue.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    if redRolls == 0 and blueRolls == 0 then
        return ""
    end

    local youIsRed = (viewerSide == "Red")
    local you = youIsRed and red or blue
    local opp = youIsRed and blue or red
    local youName = youIsRed and "Red" or "Blue"
    local oppName = youIsRed and "Blue" or "Red"

    local youMean = you and (tonumber(you.average) or 0) or 0
    local oppMean = opp and (tonumber(opp.average) or 0) or 0
    local youDelta = you and (tonumber(you.deltaFromExpected) or 0) or 0
    local oppDelta = opp and (tonumber(opp.deltaFromExpected) or 0) or 0

    local lead = youMean - oppMean
    local leadStr
    if math.abs(lead) < 0.05 then
        leadStr = "neck and neck"
    elseif lead > 0 then
        leadStr = string.format("%s leads by %.2f", youName, lead)
    else
        leadStr = string.format("%s leads by %.2f", oppName, -lead)
    end

    return string.format(
        "HEAD TO HEAD  (%s vs %s):  %s\n%s mean %.2f (%+.1f vs expected)      %s mean %.2f (%+.1f vs expected)",
        youName, oppName, leadStr,
        youName, youMean, youDelta,
        oppName, oppMean, oppDelta)
end

weightedGoodRollWeights = {
    oneDie = 3,
    twoDice = 2,
    default = 1
}

function countGoodDice(faceCounts)
    local good = 0
    for face = 4, 6 do
        good = good + (tonumber(faceCounts and faceCounts[face]) or 0)
    end
    return good
end

function countDice(faceCounts)
    local total = 0
    for face = 1, 6 do
        total = total + (tonumber(faceCounts and faceCounts[face]) or 0)
    end
    return total
end

function emptyImportantImpactMetrics()
    return {
        pools = 0,
        dice = 0,
        weightedDice = 0,
        weightedGood = 0,
        weightedExpected = 0,
        weightedDelta = 0,
        faceCounts = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
    }
end

function addImportantBucketMetrics(metrics, bucket, weight)
    bucket = bucket or {}
    local dice = tonumber(bucket.dice) or 0
    local pools = tonumber(bucket.pools) or 0
    local sum = tonumber(bucket.sum) or 0
    local faces = bucket.faceCounts or {}

    metrics.pools = metrics.pools + pools
    metrics.dice = metrics.dice + dice
    metrics.weightedDice = metrics.weightedDice + (dice * weight)
    metrics.weightedGood = metrics.weightedGood + (countGoodDice(faces) * weight)
    metrics.weightedExpected = metrics.weightedExpected + (dice * 3.5 * weight)
    metrics.weightedDelta = metrics.weightedDelta + ((sum - (dice * 3.5)) * weight)

    for face = 1, 6 do
        metrics.faceCounts[face] = metrics.faceCounts[face] + (tonumber(faces[face]) or 0)
    end
end

function importantImpactMetrics(analytics, roundNo)
    local metrics = emptyImportantImpactMetrics()
    if not analytics then
        return metrics
    end

    local important = analytics.importantRolls or {}
    local source = important
    if roundNo ~= nil then
        source = important.rounds and important.rounds[roundNo] or nil
    end

    if type(source) ~= "table" then
        return metrics
    end

    addImportantBucketMetrics(metrics, source.oneDie, weightedGoodRollWeights.oneDie)
    addImportantBucketMetrics(metrics, source.twoDice, weightedGoodRollWeights.twoDice)
    return metrics
end

function importantGoodPercent(metrics)
    if not metrics or metrics.weightedDice <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return (metrics.weightedGood / metrics.weightedDice) * 100
end

function importantImpactPercent(metrics)
    if not metrics or metrics.weightedExpected <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return (metrics.weightedDelta / metrics.weightedExpected) * 100
end

function formatSignedPercent(value)
    if value == nil then
        return "--%"
    end
    return string.format("%+.0f%%", value)
end

function formatImportantImpactLabel(metrics)
    local pct = importantImpactPercent(metrics)
    if pct == nil then
        return "No important rolls"
    end
    if pct > 1 then
        return "Helped " .. formatSignedPercent(pct)
    elseif pct < -1 then
        return "Hurt " .. formatSignedPercent(pct)
    end
    return "Even " .. formatSignedPercent(pct)
end

function formatImportantFaces(faceCounts)
    local values = {}
    for face = 1, 6 do
        table.insert(values, tostring(tonumber(faceCounts and faceCounts[face]) or 0))
    end
    return table.concat(values, " / ")
end

function formatImportantRoundLine(roundNo, metrics)
    if not metrics or metrics.dice <= 0 then
        return "R" .. tostring(roundNo) .. ": none"
    end

    local goodPct = importantGoodPercent(metrics) or 0
    return string.format(
        "R%d: %s | %d pools, %d dice | 4+ %.0f%%",
        roundNo,
        formatImportantImpactLabel(metrics),
        metrics.pools,
        metrics.dice,
        goodPct)
end

function buildImportantSideColumn(sideName, analytics)
    local total = importantImpactMetrics(analytics)
    if not analytics then
        return sideName .. "\nRoller not found."
    end
    if total.dice <= 0 then
        return sideName .. "\nNo important rolls yet."
    end

    local goodPct = importantGoodPercent(total) or 0
    local lines = {
        sideName .. " IMPORTANT ROLLS",
        string.format("Total: %d pools, %d dice | 4+ %.0f%%", total.pools, total.dice, goodPct),
        "Impact: " .. formatImportantImpactLabel(total),
        "Faces 1-6: " .. formatImportantFaces(total.faceCounts)
    }

    for roundNo = 1, 5 do
        table.insert(lines, formatImportantRoundLine(roundNo, importantImpactMetrics(analytics, roundNo)))
    end

    return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

function buildImportantLuckVerdict(red, blue)
    local redTotal = importantImpactMetrics(red)
    local blueTotal = importantImpactMetrics(blue)
    if redTotal.dice <= 0 and blueTotal.dice <= 0 then
        return "Important-roll luck: no 1D or 2D rolls recorded yet."
    end

    local redPct = importantImpactPercent(redTotal) or 0
    local bluePct = importantImpactPercent(blueTotal) or 0
    local diff = redPct - bluePct
    local overall
    if math.abs(diff) < 2 then
        overall = "Overall: effectively even"
    elseif diff > 0 then
        overall = "Overall: Red had more important-roll help by " .. formatSignedPercent(math.abs(diff))
    else
        overall = "Overall: Blue had more important-roll help by " .. formatSignedPercent(math.abs(diff))
    end

    local rounds = {}
    for roundNo = 1, 5 do
        local redRound = importantImpactMetrics(red, roundNo)
        local blueRound = importantImpactMetrics(blue, roundNo)
        if redRound.dice <= 0 and blueRound.dice <= 0 then
            table.insert(rounds, "R" .. tostring(roundNo) .. " none")
        else
            local roundDiff = (importantImpactPercent(redRound) or 0) - (importantImpactPercent(blueRound) or 0)
            if math.abs(roundDiff) < 2 then
                table.insert(rounds, "R" .. tostring(roundNo) .. " even")
            elseif roundDiff > 0 then
                table.insert(rounds, "R" .. tostring(roundNo) .. " Red +" .. string.format("%.0f%%", math.abs(roundDiff)))
            else
                table.insert(rounds, "R" .. tostring(roundNo) .. " Blue +" .. string.format("%.0f%%", math.abs(roundDiff)))
            end
        end
    end

    return overall .. "\nRound winners: " .. table.concat(rounds, "  |  ")
end

function weightedGoodRollPercent(analytics)
    if not analytics then
        return nil
    end

    local allFaces = analytics.faceCounts or {}
    local allDice = countDice(allFaces)
    if allDice <= 0 then
        return nil
    end

    local important = analytics.importantRolls or {}
    local oneFaces = important.oneDie and important.oneDie.faceCounts or {}
    local twoFaces = important.twoDice and important.twoDice.faceCounts or {}

    local weightedDice = allDice
    local weightedGood = countGoodDice(allFaces)

    local oneExtra = weightedGoodRollWeights.oneDie - weightedGoodRollWeights.default
    local twoExtra = weightedGoodRollWeights.twoDice - weightedGoodRollWeights.default

    weightedDice = weightedDice + (countDice(oneFaces) * oneExtra) + (countDice(twoFaces) * twoExtra)
    weightedGood = weightedGood + (countGoodDice(oneFaces) * oneExtra) + (countGoodDice(twoFaces) * twoExtra)

    if weightedDice <= 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return (weightedGood / weightedDice) * 100
end

function formatWeightedGoodRollPercent(analytics, label)
    local percent = weightedGoodRollPercent(analytics)
    if not percent then
        return label .. " GOOD --%"
    end
    return string.format("%s GOOD %.0f%%", label, percent)
end

function buildDiceStatsBoardSide(sideName, analytics)
    if not analytics then
        return sideName .. "\nRoller not found."
    end

    local total = tonumber(analytics.totalRolls) or 0
    if total <= 0 then
        return sideName .. "\nNo rolls yet."
    end

    local counts = analytics.faceCounts or {}
    local goodPct = (countGoodDice(counts) / total) * 100
    local faces = {}
    for face = 1, 6 do
        table.insert(faces, tostring(face) .. ":" .. tostring(tonumber(counts[face]) or 0))
    end

    return sideName .. "\n" ..
        string.format("Dice %d | Avg %.2f | 4+ %.0f%%", total, tonumber(analytics.average) or 0, goodPct) .. "\n" ..
        "Faces  " .. table.concat(faces, "  ") .. "\n" ..
        "Important: " .. formatImportantImpactLabel(importantImpactMetrics(analytics))
end

function getDiceStatsBoardText(params)
    params = params or {}
    local viewerSide = params.side or "Red"
    local red = getDiceStatsAnalytics(redCustomDiceRoller_GUID)
    local blue = getDiceStatsAnalytics(blueCustomDiceRoller_GUID)

    return {
        title = "DICE STATS",
        balance = buildDiceStatsBalanceLine(red, blue),
        red = buildDiceStatsBoardSide("RED", red),
        blue = buildDiceStatsBoardSide("BLUE", blue),
        important = buildImportantLuckVerdict(red, blue),
        headToHead = buildDiceStatsHeadToHead(red, blue, viewerSide)
    }
end

function updateWeightedGoodRollsHUD()
    local red = getDiceStatsAnalytics(redCustomDiceRoller_GUID)
    local blue = getDiceStatsAnalytics(blueCustomDiceRoller_GUID)
    setHudValue({id = "GoodRollsRed", value = formatWeightedGoodRollPercent(red, "RED")})
    setHudValue({id = "GoodRollsBlue", value = formatWeightedGoodRollPercent(blue, "BLUE")})
end

local function safeUiCall(fn)
    local ok, err = pcall(fn)
    if not ok then
        print("[DiceStats] UI error: " .. tostring(err))
    end
end

-- Called from the Control Panel button. params = { viewer = <player color>, side = <board color> }.
function showDiceStatsPanel(params)
    params = params or {}
    local viewer = params.viewer or params.side or "Red"
    local viewerSide = params.side or params.viewer or "Red"

    -- Show the panel first so the player always sees it, even if a read fails.
    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setAttribute("diceStatsPanel", "visibility", viewer) end)
    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setAttribute("diceStatsPanel", "active", "true") end)

    local red = getDiceStatsAnalytics(redCustomDiceRoller_GUID)
    local blue = getDiceStatsAnalytics(blueCustomDiceRoller_GUID)

    local redRolls = red and (tonumber(red.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    local blueRolls = blue and (tonumber(blue.totalRolls) or 0) or 0
    print("[DiceStats] viewer=" .. tostring(viewer)
        .. " redRoller=" .. tostring(redCustomDiceRoller_GUID) .. "(" .. redRolls .. " rolls)"
        .. " blueRoller=" .. tostring(blueCustomDiceRoller_GUID) .. "(" .. blueRolls .. " rolls)")

    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setValue("diceStatsRedTxt", formatDiceStatsColumn(red)) end)
    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setValue("diceStatsBlueTxt", formatDiceStatsColumn(blue)) end)
    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setValue("diceStatsBalanceTxt", buildDiceStatsBalanceLine(red, blue)) end)
    safeUiCall(function() Global.UI.setValue("diceStatsH2HTxt", buildDiceStatsHeadToHead(red, blue, viewerSide)) end)

playerHudSettings = {

function getDefaultHudSettings()
    return {settingsOpen = false, scoringOverlayOpen = false, clockHidden = false, hudVisible = true, scale = "Medium"}
end

function ensureHudSettings(color)
    if color ~= "Red" and color ~= "Blue" and color ~= "Grey" then
        color = "Blue"
    end
    if not playerHudSettings then
        playerHudSettings = {}
    end
    if not playerHudSettings[color] then
        playerHudSettings[color] = getDefaultHudSettings()
    end
    local defaults = getDefaultHudSettings()
    for key, value in pairs(defaults) do
        if playerHudSettings[color][key] == nil then
            playerHudSettings[color][key] = value
        end
    end
    return playerHudSettings[color]
end

function getHudColorFromCallback(player, id)
    if id then
        local fromId = string.match(id, "^(Red)Hud_") or string.match(id, "^(Blue)Hud_") or string.match(id, "^(Grey)Hud_")
        if fromId then
            return fromId
        end
    end
    if type(player) == "table" and player.color then
        if player.color == "Red" or player.color == "Blue" or player.color == "Grey" then
            return player.color
        end
    elseif player == "Red" or player == "Blue" or player == "Grey" then
        return player
    end
    return "Blue"
end

-- ===== HUD CP action row (PASS TURN / GAIN CP / USE CP) =====
-- GAIN CP / USE CP mutate the player's own CP counter widget directly
-- (e446f7 Red / deb9f2 Blue). The cpCounter poller then syncs the HUD CPWatch
-- text and posts the same chat line as the overlay +/- buttons, so nothing else
-- needs to be updated here. GAIN CP is capped at once per battle round per
-- player; USE CP is unlimited. PASS TURN is wired straight to the mission
-- manager's hudPassTurn (738804) in the XML, matching the ROUND badge.
cpGainRoundUsed = cpGainRoundUsed or {}   -- player color -> battle round GAIN CP was last used

function cpCounterForColor(color)
    if color == "Red" then return getObjectFromGUID(redCPCounter_GUID) end
    if color == "Blue" then return getObjectFromGUID(blueCPCounter_GUID) end
    return nil
end

function currentBattleRound()
    local roundObj = getObjectFromGUID(gameTurnCounter_GUID)
    return counterValue(roundObj)
end

function hudGainCP(player, value, id)
    local color = getHudColorFromCallback(player, id)
    if color ~= "Red" and color ~= "Blue" then return end
    local counter = cpCounterForColor(color)
    if not counter then return end
    local round = currentBattleRound()
    if cpGainRoundUsed[color] == round then
        broadcastToColor("You can't gain more CP this round.", color, "Orange")
        return
    end
    cpGainRoundUsed[color] = round
    local ok = pcall(function()
        counter.call("incrementWithActor", {actorColor = color})
    end)
    if not ok then counterIncrement(counter) end
    setHudAttribute({id = (color == "Blue" and "CPWatch1" or "CPWatch2"), attr = "text", value = "CP: " .. counterValue(counter)})
end

function hudUseCP(player, value, id)
    local color = getHudColorFromCallback(player, id)
    if color ~= "Red" and color ~= "Blue" then return end
    local counter = cpCounterForColor(color)
    if not counter then return end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        counter.call("decrementWithActor", {actorColor = color})
    end)
    if not ok then counterDecrement(counter) end
    setHudAttribute({id = (color == "Blue" and "CPWatch1" or "CPWatch2"), attr = "text", value = "CP: " .. counterValue(counter)})
end

-- ===== Minimalist HUD (per player, toggled by the "-" control button) =====
-- Minimalist mode hides the PASS/GAIN/USE CP action row (Row3) and both per-turn
-- phase-icon strips, then resizes the panel + control column to fit. Red and Blue
-- are independent (separate panels); Grey has no "-" button so it is never minimal.
hudMinimalist = hudMinimalist or {}   -- player color -> bool

-- Per-mode geometry. Minimalist drops the panel width by the phase-strip width and
-- the height by the Row3 line, and shrinks the 4-button control column (and its
-- font) so the glyphs still fit. width/height are visual estimates — tune in-game.
local HUD_FULL = { width = "1160", height = "270", controlsH = "214", rightColH = "214", btnFont = "28", shown = "true"  }
local HUD_MIN  = { width = "740",  height = "155", controlsH = "143", rightColH = "143", btnFont = "24", shown = "false" }

-- The clock readout + its steppers (same id set the clock-hide toggle uses).
local HUD_CLOCK_IDS = {"ClockSubPanel1", "ClockSubPanel2", "ChsStpPlus1", "ChsStpMinus1", "ChsStpPlus2", "ChsStpMinus2"}

function applyMinimalistForColor(color)
    if color ~= "Red" and color ~= "Blue" then return end
    local minimal = hudMinimalist[color]
    local d = minimal and HUD_MIN or HUD_FULL
    local p = color .. "Hud_"
    -- Minimalist always hides the clock; full mode hands it back to the player's
    -- own clock toggle so we don't override a manually hidden clock.
    local clockShown = (not minimal) and (not ensureHudSettings(color).clockHidden)
    pcall(function()
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "Row3",      "active", d.shown)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "PhaseRow1", "active", d.shown)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "PhaseRow2", "active", d.shown)
        for _, id in ipairs(HUD_CLOCK_IDS) do
            Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. id, "active", clockShown and "true" or "false")
        end
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "VPScores",  "width",  d.width)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "VPScores",  "height", d.height)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(color .. "HudControls", "preferredHeight", d.controlsH)
        Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. "RightCol", "preferredHeight", d.rightColH)
        for _, b in ipairs({"SettingsBtn", "LockBtn", "ClockBtn", "MinusBtn"}) do
            Global.UI.setAttribute(p .. b, "fontSize", d.btnFont)
        end
    end)
end

function formatSecondaryListColumns(names, cap, numbered)
    if not names or #names == 0 then return "—", "" end
    local count = #names
    if cap and count > cap then count = cap end
    local splitAt = math.ceil(count / 2)
    local left = {}
    local right = {}
    for i = 1, count do
        local line
        if numbered then
            line = i .. ". " .. names[i]
        else
            line = "• " .. names[i]
        end
        if i <= splitAt then
            left[#left + 1] = line
        else
            right[#right + 1] = line
        end
    end
    return table.concat(left, "\n"), table.concat(right, "\n")
end

function setHudListColumns(id, names, cap, numbered)
    local left, right = formatSecondaryListColumns(names, cap, numbered)
    setHudValue({id = id .. "L", value = left})
    setHudValue({id = id .. "R", value = right})
end

function isAnyScoringOverlayOpen()
    for _, color in ipairs({"Red", "Blue", "Grey"}) do
        local settings = ensureHudSettings(color)
        if settings.scoringOverlayOpen then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

function scheduleScoringOverlayRefreshLoop()
    if scoringOverlayRefreshScheduled then
        return
    end
    scoringOverlayRefreshScheduled = true
    Wait.time(function()
        scoringOverlayRefreshScheduled = false
        if not isAnyScoringOverlayOpen() then
            return
        end
        refreshScoringOverlay()
        scheduleScoringOverlayRefreshLoop()
    end, 2)
end

function getActiveSecondaryNames(color)
    local zoneGuids = (color == "Red") and redSecondaryCardZone_GUIDs or blueSecondaryCardZone_GUIDs
    local names = {}
    for _, guid in ipairs(zoneGuids) do
        local zone = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        local name = getSecondaryCardName(zone)
        if name then
            names[#names + 1] = name
        end
    end
    return names
end

function getRemainingDeckSecondaryNames(color)
    local deck = getSecondaryDeckByColor(color)
    if not deck then return {} end
    local names = {}
    local contents = deck.getObjects()
    if contents then
        for _, descriptor in ipairs(contents) do
            if descriptor.name and descriptor.name ~= "" then
                names[#names + 1] = descriptor.name
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(names)
    return names
end

function getDiscardedSecondaryNames(color)
    local pos = getSecondaryDiscardPosition(color)
    if not pos then return {} end
    local names = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local tag = obj.tag
        if tag == "Card" or tag == "Deck" then
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            if math.abs(objPos.x - pos.x) < 2.5 and math.abs(objPos.z - pos.z) < 2.5 then
                if tag == "Card" then
                    local n = obj.getName()
                    if n and n ~= "" then
                        names[#names + 1] = n
                    end
                else
                    local contents = obj.getObjects()
                    if contents then
                        for _, descriptor in ipairs(contents) do
                            if descriptor.name and descriptor.name ~= "" then
                                names[#names + 1] = descriptor.name
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return names
end

function refreshScoringOverlay()
    local sheet = getObjectFromGUID(scoresheet_GUID)
    if not sheet then return end
    local summary = sheet.call("getMatchSummary")
    if not summary then return end

    local roundCounter = getObjectFromGUID(gameTurnCounter_GUID)
    local roundNum = counterValue(roundCounter)
    setHudValue({id = "ScoringOverlay_Title", value = "⚔ Round " .. roundNum .. " ⚔"})

    local redName = summary.red.name or "Red"
    local blueName = summary.blue.name or "Blue"
    local redTotal = summary.red.total or 0
    local blueTotal = summary.blue.total or 0
    setHudValue({id = "ScoringOverlay_RedName", value = redName .. " (" .. redTotal .. ")"})
    setHudValue({id = "ScoringOverlay_BlueName", value = blueName .. " (" .. blueTotal .. ")"})

    local redRoundsText = ""
    local blueRoundsText = ""
    for j = 1, 5 do
        local r = summary.red.rounds and summary.red.rounds[j] or {}
        local b = summary.blue.rounds and summary.blue.rounds[j] or {}
        redRoundsText = redRoundsText .. string.format("<b>Round %d</b> | PRI: %d - SEC: %d |\n",
            j, r.primary or 0, r.secondary or 0)
        blueRoundsText = blueRoundsText .. string.format("<b>Round %d</b> | PRI: %d - SEC: %d |\n",
            j, b.primary or 0, b.secondary or 0)
    end
    setHudValue({id = "ScoringOverlay_RedRounds", value = redRoundsText})
    setHudValue({id = "ScoringOverlay_BlueRounds", value = blueRoundsText})

    local redActive = getActiveSecondaryNames("Red")
    local blueActive = getActiveSecondaryNames("Blue")
    local redDiscard = getDiscardedSecondaryNames("Red")
    local blueDiscard = getDiscardedSecondaryNames("Blue")
    local redDeck = getRemainingDeckSecondaryNames("Red")
    local blueDeck = getRemainingDeckSecondaryNames("Blue")

    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_RedActive", redActive, 8, true)
    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_BlueActive", blueActive, 8, true)
    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_RedDiscard", redDiscard, nil, false)
    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_BlueDiscard", blueDiscard, nil, false)
    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_RedDeck", redDeck, nil, false)
    setHudListColumns("ScoringOverlay_BlueDeck", blueDeck, nil, false)

    -- Dynamic, symmetric section heights based on content count.
    -- Both sides get the same height per section (max of red/blue) so columns line up.
    local lineHeight = 22
    local minSection = 26  -- room for "—" placeholder
    local function sectionH(count)
        if count <= 0 then return minSection end
        return math.ceil(count / 2) * lineHeight + 4
    end
    local activeCount = math.max(math.min(#redActive, 8), math.min(#blueActive, 8))
    local discardCount = math.max(#redDiscard, #blueDiscard)
    local deckCount = math.max(#redDeck, #blueDeck)

    local activeH = sectionH(activeCount)
    local discardH = sectionH(discardCount)
    local deckH = sectionH(deckCount)

    -- If total exceeds the panel's content budget, scale all sections down proportionally.
    local contentBudget = 770
    local needed = activeH + discardH + deckH
    if needed > contentBudget then
        local scale = contentBudget / needed
        activeH = math.floor(activeH * scale)
        discardH = math.floor(discardH * scale)
        deckH = math.floor(deckH * scale)
    end

    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_RedActive", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(activeH)})
    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_BlueActive", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(activeH)})
    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_RedDiscard", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(discardH)})
    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_BlueDiscard", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(discardH)})
    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_RedDeck", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(deckH)})
    setHudAttribute({id = "ScoringOverlay_BlueDeck", attr = "preferredHeight", value = tostring(deckH)})
end

-- Function to check if the objects exist in the game
function checkForMonitoredID()
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(monitoredID)
    local obj2 = getObjectFromGUID(monitoredID2)

    if obj2 ~= nil then
        -- If monitoredID2 is found, it means a malicious script was detected
        if not detectedMissing then
            detectedMissing = true
            broadcastToAll("Reminder!!! A infected object has been loaded.... please leave the game and clean all objects.", "Red")

            -- Stop further polling
            stopPolling()
        end
    elseif obj == nil then
        -- If monitoredID is missing, it means the detector was deleted, possible cheating
        if not detectedMissing then
            detectedMissing = true
            broadcastToAll("Warning: Somebody is cheating!", "Red")

            -- Start issuing warnings every 10 seconds
            warningInterval = Wait.time(function()
                broadcastToAll("Warning: Somebody is cheating!", "Red")
            end, 10, -1)

            -- Stop further polling
            stopPolling()
        end
    end
end

-- Start polling every 30 seconds
function startPolling()
    checkForMonitoredID()  -- Initial check immediately
    pollInterval = Wait.time(checkForMonitoredID, 30, -1)
end

-- Stop polling when needed
function stopPolling()
    if pollInterval ~= nil then
        Wait.stop(pollInterval)
        pollInterval = nil
    end

    if warningInterval ~= nil then
        Wait.stop(warningInterval)
        warningInterval = nil
    end
end

function updateTeamModel(obj, team)
    local teamModels = Global.getTable("teamModels") or { Red = {}, Blue = {} }
    -- Remove the object's GUID from any team it might already be in.
    for _, t in ipairs({"Red", "Blue"}) do
        for i = #teamModels[t], 1, -1 do
            if teamModels[t][i] == obj.getGUID() then
                table.remove(teamModels[t], i)
            end
        end
    end
    -- Add the object to the proper team.
    table.insert(teamModels[team], obj.getGUID())
    Global.setTable("teamModels", teamModels)
end

    local orig = getObjectFromGUID(guid)

    local data = JSON.decode(orig.getJSON())
    data.Transform.posX = -data.Transform.posX
    data.Transform.posZ = -data.Transform.posZ
    data.Transform.rotY = (data.Transform.rotY + 180) % 360
    spawnObjectJSON({
        json = JSON.encode(data),
        callback_function = function(obj) obj.lock() end
    })
end

    if _person.steam_id == redPlayerID then
        if Player.Red.seated then
            Player.Red.changeColor("Grey")

        _person.changeColor("Red")
        _person.team="None"
        return
    end
    if _person.steam_id == bluePlayerID then
        if Player.Blue.seated then
            Player.Blue.changeColor("Grey")
        end
        _person.changeColor("Blue")
        _person.team="None"
        return
    end
    --_person.changeColor("Grey")
    _person.team="None"
end

function getStartMenuObject()
    local guid = Global.getVar("startMenu_GUID")

    end
    return getObjectFromGUID(guid)
end

function getTrackingConsentPopupState(side)
    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        return nil
    end
    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return startMenu.call("getTrackedConsentPanelState", { side = side })
    end)
    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end
    return data
end

function getTrackedPublicProfileUrlForSeat(side)
    if side ~= "Red" and side ~= "Blue" then
        return nil
    end

    local state = getTrackingConsentPopupState(side)
    if type(state) ~= "table" or state.status ~= "accepted" then
        return nil
    end

    local steamId = state.steamId and tostring(state.steamId) or nil
    if steamId == nil or steamId == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, profileUrl = pcall(function()
        return startMenu.call("getTrackedProfileViewerUrlForSteamId", { steamId = steamId })
    end)
    if not ok or type(profileUrl) ~= "string" or profileUrl == "" then
        return nil
    end

    return profileUrl
end

function showTrackedPublicProfileUrlForSeat(side)
    local profileUrl = getTrackedPublicProfileUrlForSeat(side)
    if not profileUrl then
        return
    end
    printToColor("Your public stats URL: " .. tostring(profileUrl), side, "Green")
end

function getTrackingConsentSeatForPlayer(player, preferredSeat)
    if preferredSeat == "Red" or preferredSeat == "Blue" then
        return preferredSeat
    end
    if not player then
        return nil
    end

    local playerColor = player.color
    if playerColor == "Red" or playerColor == "Blue" then
        return playerColor
    end

    local steamId = player.steam_id and tostring(player.steam_id) or nil
    if steamId and steamId ~= "" then
        if Player.Red and tostring(Player.Red.steam_id or "") == steamId then
            return "Red"
        end
        if Player.Blue and tostring(Player.Blue.steam_id or "") == steamId then
            return "Blue"
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function openTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
    if side ~= "Red" and side ~= "Blue" then
        return
    end

    local state = getTrackingConsentPopupState(side)
    if state and state.status == "accepted" then
        closeTrackingConsentPopup()

    end

    Global.UI.setAttribute("trackingConsentTitle", "text", "UNLOCK GAME STATS AND MATCH FEATURES")
    Global.UI.setAttribute(
        "trackingConsentBody",
        "text",
        buildTrackingConsentBodyText(side, state)
    )
    Global.UI.setAttribute("trackingConsentPopup", "visibility", side)
    Global.UI.setAttribute("trackingConsentPopup", "active", "true")
end

function onTrackedConsentCheckComplete(params)
    local side = params and params.side or nil
    local requestId = params and params.requestId or nil
    if side ~= "Red" and side ~= "Blue" then
        return
    end
    if trackedConsentCheckPendingBySide[side] ~= requestId then
        return
    end

    trackedConsentCheckPendingBySide[side] = nil
    openTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
end

function showTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
    if side ~= "Red" and side ~= "Blue" then
        return
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        openTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
        return
    end

    trackedConsentCheckRequestId = trackedConsentCheckRequestId + 1
    trackedConsentCheckPendingBySide[side] = trackedConsentCheckRequestId

    local ok = pcall(function()
        startMenu.call("primeTrackedConsentCheck", {
            side = side,
            requestId = trackedConsentCheckRequestId
        })
    end)

    if not ok then
        trackedConsentCheckPendingBySide[side] = nil
        openTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
    end
end

function showTrackingConsentPopupForPlayer(player, preferredSeat)
    local side = getTrackingConsentSeatForPlayer(player, preferredSeat)
    if side ~= "Red" and side ~= "Blue" then
        return
    end
    showTrackingConsentPopupForSeat(side)
end

function closeTrackingConsentPopup(player, value, id)

        end
    end

    return zones
end

function getCardsInSecondarySlot(zone)
    if not zone then
        return {}
    end

    local found = {}
    local seen = {}
    local function add(obj)
        if obj and (obj.tag == "Card" or obj.tag == "Deck" or obj.type == "Card" or obj.type == "Deck") and not seen[obj.getGUID()] then
            seen[obj.getGUID()] = true
            found[#found + 1] = obj
        end
    end

    for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
        add(obj)
    end

    local bounds = zone.getBounds()
    local center = bounds.center
    local halfX = bounds.size.x / 2
    local halfZ = bounds.size.z / 2
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        local pos = obj.getPosition()
        if math.abs(pos.x - center.x) <= halfX and
           math.abs(pos.z - center.z) <= halfZ and
           pos.y > 0.5 and pos.y < 3.0 then
            add(obj)
        end
    end

    return found
end

secondaryDrawBusy = {Red = false, Blue = false}

function drawSecondaryToFirstOpenSlot(params)
    if secondaryDrawBusy[params.color] then
        broadcastToColor("Hold on - previous draw still in progress.", params.color, "Yellow")
        return
    end

    if not packSelected or not missionPackData[packSelected] then
        broadcastToColor("Select a mission pack before drawing secondary cards.", params.color, "Yellow")
        return
    end

    local deckObj = getObjectFromGUID(missionPackData[packSelected][params.deckGuidKey])
    if not deckObj then
        broadcastToColor(params.deckMissingMessage, params.color, "Red")
        return
    end

    local maxCards = params.maxCards or 2
    local openSlots = {}
    for _, slot in ipairs(getSecondaryCardZones(params.zoneGuids)) do
        if #getCardsInSecondarySlot(slot.zone) == 0 then
            openSlots[#openSlots + 1] = slot
            if #openSlots >= maxCards then break end
        end
    end

    if #openSlots == 0 then
        broadcastToColor(params.fullMessage, params.color, "Yellow")
        return
    end

    secondaryDrawBusy[params.color] = true
    deckObj.shuffle()

    for _, slot in ipairs(openSlots) do
        deckObj.takeObject({
            position = getSecondarySlotCardPosition(slot.zone),
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 180},
            flip = true,
            smooth = true,
            callback_function = function(card)
                Wait.frames(function()
                    card.locked = true
                    params.refreshNames()
                end)
            end
        })
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        secondaryDrawBusy[params.color] = false
    end, 1.5)
end

function discardSecondarySlot(params)
    local color = params.color
    local zone = getSecondaryCardZoneByIndex(color, params.index)
    if not zone then
        broadcastToColor("Secondary slot could not be found.", color, "Red")
        return
    end

    local discardPosition = getSecondaryDiscardPosition(color)
    for _, object in ipairs(getCardsInSecondarySlot(zone)) do
        object.locked = false
        object.setPositionSmooth(discardPosition)
    end

    Wait.time(function() refreshSecondaryNamesForColor(color) end, 0.25)
end

function recycleSecondarySlot(params)
    local color = params.color
    local zone = getSecondaryCardZoneByIndex(color, params.index)
    if not zone then
        broadcastToColor("Secondary slot could not be found.", color, "Red")
        return
    end

    local deckObj = getSecondaryDeckByColor(color)
    if not deckObj then
        broadcastToColor(color .. " secondary deck could not be found.", color, "Red")
        return
    end

    local recycledAny = false
    for _, object in ipairs(getCardsInSecondarySlot(zone)) do
        object.locked = false
        deckObj = deckObj.putObject(object) or deckObj
        recycledAny = true
    end

    if not recycledAny then
        return
    end

    deckObj.shuffle()
    Wait.frames(function()
        deckObj.takeObject({
            position = getSecondarySlotCardPosition(zone),
            rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 180},
            flip = true,
            smooth = true,
            callback_function = function(card)
                Wait.frames(function()
                    card.locked = true
                    refreshSecondaryNamesForColor(color)
                end)
            end
        })
    end, 2)
end

function getIcons(obj)

function addIcon(obj, icon, uid, url, isFloor)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()
    globalFloatingIcons[guid] = globalFloatingIcons[guid] or {}
    table.insert(globalFloatingIcons[guid], { obj = icon, updateID = uid, imageURL = url, isFloor = isFloor })

function removeIcon(obj, url, isFloor)
    local guid = obj.getGUID()
    local icons = globalFloatingIcons[guid]
    if not icons then return end
    for i = #icons, 1, -1 do
        local e = icons[i]
        if e.imageURL == url and e.isFloor == isFloor then
            if e.updateID then Wait.stop(e.updateID) end
            e.obj.destroy()
            table.remove(icons, i)
        end
    end
    if #icons == 0 then globalFloatingIcons[guid] = nil end
end

    local guid = obj.getGUID()

    if not icons then return end
    for _, e in ipairs(icons) do

    end
    globalFloatingIcons[guid] = nil

function toggleFloatingIconGeneric(params)
    local floorObj = getObjectFromGUID(felt_GUID)
    local FLOOR_Y = floorObj and floorObj.getPosition().y or 1

    local obj = params.hoveredObject or params.obj
    local url = params.imageURL
    local isFloor = params.floor == true
    local name = (params.name or ""):lower()
    if not obj then return end

    for _, e in ipairs(getIcons(obj)) do
        if e.imageURL == url and e.isFloor == isFloor then
            removeIcon(obj, url, isFloor)
            return
        end
    end

    -- size category
    local name = (params.name or ""):lower()
    local isMedium, isExtraLarge, isLarge = false, false, false
    for _, k in ipairs(mediumNames)     do if name:find(k,1,true) then isMedium     = true break end end
    for _, k in ipairs(extraLargeNames) do if name:find(k,1,true) then isExtraLarge = true break end end
    if not isMedium and not isExtraLarge then
        for _, k in ipairs(largeNames) do if name:find(k,1,true) then isLarge = true break end end
    end

    local normalH, normalO, normalS = 5,  -2,   1.2
    local largeH,  largeO,  largeS  = 8,  -3,   1.8
    local medH,    medO,    medS    = 6,  -2.5, 1.5
    local exH,     exO,     exS     = 10, -4,   2
    local baseH, baseO, baseS = normalH, normalO, normalS
    if     isExtraLarge then baseH, baseO, baseS = exH,   exO,   exS
    elseif isLarge      then baseH, baseO, baseS = largeH, largeO, largeS
    elseif isMedium     then baseH, baseO, baseS = medH,   medO,   medS end

    local b0 = obj.getBounds()
    local halfHeight0 = b0.size.y / 2
    local minDist0 = b0.size.x / 2 + 1.2
    local sign0 = (baseO < 0) and -1 or 1
    local bottom0 = b0.center.y - halfHeight0
    local spawnY = isFloor and math.max(bottom0, FLOOR_Y) or (b0.center.y + halfHeight0 + baseH)
    if isFloor then spawnY = math.min(spawnY, 1.3) end
    local spawnX = isFloor and (b0.center.x + sign0 * minDist0) or b0.center.x
    local spawnZ = b0.center.z

    local icon = spawnObject({
        type         = "Custom_Token",
        position     = {spawnX, spawnY, spawnZ},
        rotation     = {0, obj.getRotation().y, 0},
        scale        = {0.4,0.4,0.4},
        cast_shadows = false,
    })
    icon.setCustomObject({
        image          = url,
        thickness      = 0.05+tokenHeights[params.extraHeightId],
        merge_distance = 0.2,
        stand_up       = false,
        stackable      = false,
    })
    icon.setLock(true)
    -- icon.setColorTint({1,1,1,0.95})

    local function follow()
        local b = obj.getBounds()
        local halfH = b.size.y / 2
        local minDist = b.size.x / 2 + 1.2
        local bottom = b.center.y - halfH
        local sign = (baseO < 0) and -1 or 1
        local maxStep = 1
        local fh   = math.max(bottom, FLOOR_Y)
        local floorPos = math.max(b.center.y - halfH, FLOOR_Y)
        local vel = obj.getVelocity() or {x=0,y=0,z=0}
        local speed = math.sqrt(vel.x*vel.x + vel.y*vel.y + vel.z*vel.z)
        local useY = floorPos
        if isFloor and speed > 0 then useY = math.min(useY, 1.2) end

        local icons= getIcons(obj)

        if isFloor then
            -- Arrange floor icons on an orbit that follows the object's yaw.
            local floors, prev = {}, minDist
            for _, e in ipairs(getIcons(obj)) do if e.isFloor then table.insert(floors, e) end end
            local count = #floors
            if count > 0 then
                -- compute radii preserving incremental spacing behavior
                local radii = {}
                for i = 1, count do
                    local dist = (i == 1) and minDist or (prev + math.min(minDist * (baseS^(i-1)) - prev, maxStep))
                    prev = dist
                    radii[i] = dist
                end

                -- base angle follows object's yaw
                local baseAngle = math.rad(obj.getRotation().y or 0)
                for i, e in ipairs(floors) do
                    local offset = ((i-1) - (count-1)/2) * (2 * math.pi / math.max(count,1))
                    local angle = baseAngle + offset
                    local r = radii[i]
                    local x = b.center.x + math.cos(angle) * r * sign
                    local z = b.center.z + math.sin(angle) * r
                    local rotY = (math.deg(angle) + 90) % 360
                    e.obj.setRotation({0, rotY, 0})
                    e.obj.setPosition({ x, useY, z }, false)
                end
            end
        else
            local floats = {}
            for _, e in ipairs(getIcons(obj)) do if not e.isFloor then table.insert(floats, e) end end
            local spacing = math.min(minDist * baseS, maxStep)
            local totalW = (#floats - 1) * spacing
            for i, e in ipairs(floats) do
                local off = -totalW/2 + (i-1)*spacing
                e.obj.setRotation({0, obj.getRotation().y, 0})
                e.obj.setPosition({ b.center.x + off, b.center.y + halfH + baseH, b.center.z }, false)
            end
        end
    end

    Wait.frames(follow, 2)
    local uid = Wait.time(follow, 0.01, -1)
    addIcon(obj, icon, uid, url, isFloor)
end

function onObjectDestroy(obj)
    local objGUID = obj.getGUID()
    for originGUID, icons in pairs(globalFloatingIcons) do
        for i, e in ipairs(icons) do
            if e.obj and e.obj.getGUID() == objGUID then
                if e.updateID then Wait.stop(e.updateID) end
                table.remove(icons, i)
                if #icons == 0 then globalFloatingIcons[originGUID] = nil end
                return
            end
        end
    end
    clearIcons(obj)
end
