ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.Name: CardCustom
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Dis vs PA 1 - Sweeping Engagement - BTTF
ContainedObjects.Description: Battlemaster TTS loader card. Press Load Map to spawn the embedded payload.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.Name: CardCustom
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Dis vs PA 2 - Tipping Point - BTTF
ContainedObjects.Description: Battlemaster TTS loader card. Press Load Map to spawn the embedded payload.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.Name: CardCustom
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Dis vs PA 3 - Search and Destroy - BTTF
ContainedObjects.Description: Battlemaster TTS loader card. Press Load Map to spawn the embedded payload.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.Name: CardCustom
ContainedObjects.Nickname: Dis vs PA 2 - Tipping Point - Cra5hNatural
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- TO CHANGE THE SIZE OF THE AREA FOR THE MAP LOADING/DELETING, READ THIS
    -- Change the zoneScale size to match a zone you create in game (as reference)
    -- Be sure the zone extends below the table too
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    zoneScale = {x=60.12, y=73, z=44.04} --60x44 Strike Force
    -------------------------------------------------------------
    function onLoad()
        self.createButton({
            label = "Load Map",
            font_size = 115,
            color = {0, 1, 0,},
            position = {-0.96, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {1.3, 1, .7},
            width = 570,
            height = 160,
            click_function = "loadMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })

        self.createButton({
            label = "Clear Map",
            font_size = 100,
            position = {1, 0.5, 0},
            rotation = {0, 90, 0},
            scale = {.6, .6, .4},
            width = 530,
            height = 130,
            color = {1, 0, 0},
            click_function = "clearMap",
            function_owner = self,
        })
    end

    string.split = function(s, delimiter)
        local result = { }
        local from  = 1
        local delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        while delim_from do
            table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from , delim_from-1 ) )
            from  = delim_to + 1
            delim_from, delim_to = string.find( s, delimiter, from  )
        end
        table.insert( result, string.sub( s, from  ) )
        return result
    end

    -- Wipe everything inside the zone except the mats/build tables and any
    -- MapExclude-tagged object. v2 defers detection a couple frames so the zone
    -- is populated first. onCleared (optional) runs only AFTER the board is
    -- verified clear and the zone removed, so a follow-up spawn can never race
    -- the wipe and leave a previously loaded map behind.
    function wipeMapZone(zone, onCleared) -- @@MAP_ZONES_V2@@ deferred detection
        Wait.frames(function()
            local keep = {["28865a"]=true, ["4ee1f2"]=true, ["6012bf"]=true, ["948ce5"]=true, ["e7ca6e"]=true}
            for _, obj in ipairs(zone.getObjects()) do
                if obj ~= self and not keep[obj.getGUID()] and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "MapExclude" then
                    obj.destruct()
                end
            end
            zone.destruct()
            if onCleared then Wait.frames(onCleared, 2) end
        end, 2)
    end

    -- Clear Map reuses the wipe with no follow-up spawn.
    function scriptzoneCallback(zone)
        wipeMapZone(zone, nil)
    end

    function spawnMapTerrain()
        for _, objectJSON in ipairs(objectJSONs) do
            spawnObjectJSON({
                json = objectJSON
            })
        end
    end

    function loadMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
    do local _m = getObjectFromGUID("738804"); if _m then local _ok = _m.call("startGameFromLoadMap", {name = self.getName(), guid = self.getGUID(), clickerColor = clickerColor}); if _ok == false then return end end end
        -- Spawn the scripting zone; its callback wipes the board and, once it is
        -- 100% clear, spawns this card's terrain. Gating the spawn on the wipe
        -- (instead of a fixed timer running alongside it) guarantees nothing from
        -- a previously loaded map survives next to the new one.
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = function(zone) wipeMapZone(zone, spawnMapTerrain) end,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

    function clearMap(objectClicked, clickerColor, altClickUsed)
        spawnObject({
            position = {x=0, y=26, z=0},
            scale = zoneScale,
            type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
            callback_function = scriptzoneCallback,
            callback_owner = self,
        })
    end

local function normalizeUiString(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return value
    end
    local text = value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    local quoted = text:match("^'(.*)'$")
    if quoted then
        return quoted
    end
    quoted = text:match('^"(.*)"$')
    if quoted then
        return quoted
    end
    return text
end

local function getStartMenuObject()
    local guid = Global.getVar("startMenu_GUID")
    if not guid or guid == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return getObjectFromGUID(guid)
end

local function getTrackingConsentState(color)
    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        return {
            status = "error",
            statusLabel = "Start menu missing",
            steamId = nil,
            displayName = nil,
        }
    end

    local ok, data = pcall(function()
        return startMenu.call("getTrackedConsentPanelState", {side = color})
    end)

    if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then
        return {
            status = "error",
            statusLabel = "Consent unavailable",
            steamId = nil,
            displayName = nil,
        }
    end

    trackingConsentPanelState[color] = data
    return data
end

local function getTrackingConsentButtonColors(status)
    if status == "accepted" then
        return "#77DD77|#66CC66|#55BB55"
    elseif status == "declined" then
        return "#FFCCCC|#FFB3B3|#FFA6A6"
    elseif status == "loading" then
        return "#FFE599|#FFD966|#F1C232"
    elseif status == "unavailable" then
        return "#D9D9D9|#CCCCCC|#B7B7B7"
    elseif status == "error" then
        return "#F4CCCC|#EA9999|#E06666"
    end
    return "#FFF2CC|#FFE599|#F1C232"
end

local function resolveDiceMatGUID(color, board)
    local candidates = {}
    local seen = {}

    local function addCandidate(guid)
        if type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "" and not seen[guid] then
            seen[guid] = true
            table.insert(candidates, guid)
        end
    end

    if board then
        addCandidate(board.DiceMat_GUID)
    end

    if color == "Red" then
        addCandidate(Global.getVar("redCustomDiceMat_GUID"))
        addCandidate("c9d2b1") -- portrait red custom dice table
        addCandidate("acae21") -- legacy red custom dice table
        addCandidate("c57d70") -- legacy red dice mat
    else
        addCandidate(Global.getVar("blueCustomDiceMat_GUID"))
        addCandidate("d4e8a2") -- portrait blue custom dice table
        addCandidate("839fcc") -- legacy blue custom dice table
        addCandidate("a84ed2") -- legacy blue dice mat
    end

    for _, guid in ipairs(candidates) do
        if getObjectFromGUID(guid) then
            return guid
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function getControlBoardObject(color)
    local boardObjectGUID = (color == "Red") and "32ed4c" or "83ab2a"
    return getObjectFromGUID(boardObjectGUID)
end

local function getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)
    local args = {...}
    for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
        if type(arg) == "table" and arg.color then
            return arg.color
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getBoardColorFromArgs(...)
    local args = {...}
    for _, arg in ipairs(args) do
        arg = normalizeUiString(arg)
        if arg == "Red" or arg == "Blue" then
            return arg
        end
    end
    return (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"
end

local function getCoord(pos, index, key)
    if type(pos) ~= "table" and type(pos) ~= "userdata" then return 0 end
    return pos[index] or pos[key] or 0
end

local function getCustomCounterOption(color)
    local board = boards[color]
    if not board then return nil, nil end
    for index, option in ipairs(board.options) do
        if option.name == "Custom Counter" then
            return option, index
        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local function pruneCustomCounterExtras(color)
    local live = {}
    for _, guid in ipairs(customCounterExtras[color] or {}) do
        if type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "" and getObjectFromGUID(guid) then
            table.insert(live, guid)
        end
    end
    customCounterExtras[color] = live
    return live
end

local function setCustomCounterStatusUi(color, state)
    local _, optionIndex = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not optionIndex then return end

    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local offColor = "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC"
    pcall(function()
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_status_" .. tostring(optionIndex), {
            text = state and "ON" or "OFF",
            colors = state and onColor or offColor,
        })
    end)
end

local function getCustomCounterPosition(color, index)
    local board = boards[color]
    local option = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not board or not option then return {0, 1, 0} end

    local base = getObjectFromGUID(board.CustomCounter)
    if base and not originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] then
        originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] = base.getPosition()
    end

    local basePos = originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] or (base and base.getPosition()) or {0, 1, 0}
    local visibleY = option.customHiddenPosition or getCoord(basePos, 2, "y")
    if type(visibleY) == "table" then
        visibleY = visibleY[2] or visibleY.y or getCoord(basePos, 2, "y")
    end

    local direction = (color == "Blue") and 1 or -1
    return {
        getCoord(basePos, 1, "x") + (direction * CUSTOM_COUNTER_SPACING * index),
        visibleY,
        getCoord(basePos, 3, "z"),
    }
end

local function hideCustomCounterObject(guid)
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not obj then return end
    if not originalPositions[guid] then
        originalPositions[guid] = obj.getPosition()
    end
    local pos = originalPositions[guid]
    obj.setPosition({
        getCoord(pos, 1, "x"),
        getCoord(pos, 2, "y") - 3,
        getCoord(pos, 3, "z"),
    })
    obj.setLock(true)
    obj.interactable = false
end

local function setCustomCounterObjectVisible(guid, position)
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not obj then return end
    if not originalPositions[guid] then
        originalPositions[guid] = obj.getPosition()
    end
    obj.setPosition(position)
    obj.setLock(true)
    obj.interactable = true
end

local function positionCustomCounters(color)
    local board = boards[color]
    local option = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not board or not option then return end

    local extras = pruneCustomCounterExtras(color)
    if option.state then
        setCustomCounterObjectVisible(board.CustomCounter, getCustomCounterPosition(color, 0))
        for index, guid in ipairs(extras) do
            setCustomCounterObjectVisible(guid, getCustomCounterPosition(color, index))
        end
    else
        hideCustomCounterObject(board.CustomCounter)
        for _, guid in ipairs(extras) do
            hideCustomCounterObject(guid)
        end
    end
end

local function setCustomCounterEnabled(color, state)

    if not option then return end
    option.state = state and true or false
    setCustomCounterStatusUi(color, option.state)

end

        return
    end

    local boardObject = getControlBoardObject(expectedColor)
    if not boardObject then
        print("Control board not found for " .. tostring(expectedColor))
        return
    end

    diceStatsBoardVisible[expectedColor] = not diceStatsBoardVisible[expectedColor]
    diceStatsBoardViewer[expectedColor] = playerColor or expectedColor

    local activeValue = diceStatsBoardVisible[expectedColor] and "true" or "false"
    pcall(function()
        boardObject.UI.setAttribute(expectedColor .. "_diceStatsBoardPanel", "visibility", diceStatsBoardViewer[expectedColor])
        boardObject.UI.setAttribute(expectedColor .. "_diceStatsBoardPanel", "active", activeValue)
        boardObject.UI.setAttributes(expectedColor .. "_diceStatsBtn", {
            text = diceStatsBoardVisible[expectedColor] and "Hide Stats" or "Dice Stats"
        })
    end)

    if diceStatsBoardVisible[expectedColor] then
        refreshDiceStatsBoard(expectedColor)
    end
end

function toggleObjectState(objectGUID, state, customHiddenPosition)
    if type(objectGUID) ~= "string" or objectGUID == "" then
        print("toggleObjectState called with invalid GUID")
        return
    end

    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(objectGUID)
    if obj then
        if not originalPositions[objectGUID] then
            originalPositions[objectGUID] = obj.getPosition()
        end

        if state then
            local newPosition
            if type(customHiddenPosition) == "table" then
                newPosition = {
                    customHiddenPosition[1] or originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                    customHiddenPosition[2] or originalPositions[objectGUID][2],
                    customHiddenPosition[3] or originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
                }
            else
                newPosition = {
                    originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                    (customHiddenPosition or originalPositions[objectGUID][2]),
                    originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
                }
            end

            obj.setPosition(newPosition)
            obj.setLock(true)
            obj.interactable = true
        else
            local hiddenPosition = {
                originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                originalPositions[objectGUID][2] - 3,
                originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
            }
            obj.setPosition(hiddenPosition)
            obj.setLock(true)
            obj.interactable = false
        end
    else
        print("Object not found: " .. objectGUID)
    end
end

function addCustomCounter(...)
    local expectedColor = getBoardColorFromArgs(...)
    local playerColor = getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local board = boards[expectedColor]
    if not board then return end

    local base = getObjectFromGUID(board.CustomCounter)
    if not base then
        print(expectedColor .. " custom counter not found")
        return
    end

    if not originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] then
        originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] = base.getPosition()
    end

    setCustomCounterEnabled(expectedColor, true)

    local spawnIndex = #pruneCustomCounterExtras(expectedColor) + 1
    local clone = base.clone({
        position = getCustomCounterPosition(expectedColor, spawnIndex),
        snap_to_grid = false,
    })
    if not clone then return end

    local tint = randomCustomCounterTint()
    clone.setColorTint({tint[1], tint[2], tint[3]})
    clone.setLock(true)
    clone.interactable = true
    if clone.setDescription then
        clone.setDescription(expectedColor)
    end

    table.insert(customCounterExtras[expectedColor], clone.getGUID())

    Wait.frames(function()
        pcall(function() clone.call("setValue", 0) end)
        positionCustomCounters(expectedColor)
    end, 2)
end

function removeCustomCounter(...)
    local expectedColor = getBoardColorFromArgs(...)
    local playerColor = getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local extras = pruneCustomCounterExtras(expectedColor)
    local guid = table.remove(extras)
    customCounterExtras[expectedColor] = extras

    if guid then
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then
            obj.destruct()
        end
    end

    positionCustomCounters(expectedColor)
end

    pruneCustomCounterExtras("Red")

function refreshTrackingConsent(player, color)
    local expectedColor = color
    if expectedColor ~= "Red" and expectedColor ~= "Blue" then
        expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"
    end

    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == "table" and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    end
    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        print("Start menu not found")
        return
    end

    setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "loading", "Checking...")

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        startMenu.call("refreshTrackedConsentStatusForSide", expectedColor)
    end)
    if not ok then
        print("Failed to refresh tracking consent: " .. tostring(err))
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "error", "Check failed")
        return
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        buildControlPanel(expectedColor)
    end, 0.2)

function chooseTrackingConsent(player, decision, color)
    local chosenDecision = nil
    local expectedColor = nil

    if type(player) == "string" and (player == "accepted" or player == "declined") then
        chosenDecision = player
        expectedColor = decision
    else
        chosenDecision = decision
        expectedColor = color
    end
    chosenDecision = normalizeUiString(chosenDecision)
    expectedColor = normalizeUiString(expectedColor)
    if expectedColor ~= "Red" and expectedColor ~= "Blue" then
        expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"
    end

    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == "table" and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    elseif type(decision) == "table" and decision.color then
        playerColor = decision.color
    elseif type(color) == "table" and color.color then
        playerColor = color.color
    end
    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        print("Start menu not found")
        return
    end

    if chosenDecision == "accepted" or chosenDecision == "declined" then
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "loading", "Loading...")
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return startMenu.call("recordTrackedConsentChoice", {
            side = expectedColor,
            decision = chosenDecision,
        })
    end)
    if not ok then
        print("Failed to save consent: " .. tostring(result))
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "error", "Save failed")
        return
    end

    if result == false then
        buildControlPanel(expectedColor)
        return
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        buildControlPanel(expectedColor)
    end, 0.2)
end

function toggleOption(player, index, color)
    -- Be tolerant of multiple calling styles from the UI:
    -- 1) toggleOption(Player, idx, 'Red')
    -- 2) toggleOption(idx, 'Red')  (TTS may inject Player automatically)
    -- debug prints removed

    -- Normalize index
    local idx = tonumber(index) or tonumber(player) or tonumber(color)
    if not idx then
        print("toggleOption: could not determine index from arguments")
        return
    end

    -- Determine expected board color (the board the script is on)
    local expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"

    -- Determine player color if available for access control
    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == 'table' and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    elseif type(index) == 'table' and index.color then
        playerColor = index.color
    elseif type(color) == 'table' and color.color then
        playerColor = color.color
    end

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local board = boards[expectedColor]
    local option = board.options[tonumber(idx)]
    if not option then
        print("toggleOption: option not found for index: " .. tostring(idx))
        return
    end
    -- Flip the state (on/off).
    option.state = not option.state

    local statusId = expectedColor .. "_status_" .. tostring(idx)
    local newText = option.state and "ON" or "OFF"

    -- Pastel color repeated 4 times: normal|hover|pressed|disabled
    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local offColor = "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC"
    local newColors = option.state and onColor or offColor

    -- Update the button's text and the multi-state color attribute.
    self.UI.setAttributes(statusId, {
        text   = newText,
        colors = newColors
    })

    -- Then do your logic for each option name:
    if option.name == "Stat Helper" then
        toggleObjectState(board.StatHelper_GUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
    elseif option.name == "Dice Roller" then
        board.DiceMat_GUID = resolveDiceMatGUID(expectedColor, board)
        toggleObjectState(board.DiceMat_GUID, option.state)
    elseif option.name == "Vortex" then
        toggleObjectState(board.VortexGUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
    elseif option.name == "Hide Hutber" then
        Global.setVar(board.lethalFace, option.state and true or false)
    elseif option.name == "Custom Counter" then
        setCustomCounterEnabled(expectedColor, option.state)
    elseif option.name == "Turn Tracker" then
        Global.call("setHudVisibilityForColor", {color = expectedColor, visible = option.state})
    elseif option.name == "Rotation 5 Degrees" then
        toggleRotationAngle(board.CustomCounter, option.state)
    end
end

local rotationAngleState = 15  -- default is 15 degrees
local rotationIncrement = 5    -- Rotation increment when the angle is toggled to "on"

function toggleRotationAngle(color)
    -- Toggle between 15 and 5 degrees.
    if rotationAngleState == 15 then
        rotationAngleState = 5
    else
        rotationAngleState = 15
    end

    -- Update the status button text.
    local statusId = color .. "_status_rotation"
    local newText = rotationAngleState .. " Degrees"

    -- Pastel color for status button
    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local newColors = rotationAngleState == 5 and "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC" or onColor

    -- Update the button's text and the multi-state color attribute.
    self.UI.setAttributes(statusId, {
        text   = newText,
        colors = newColors
    })

    -- Apply the new rotation behavior to all selected objects when the player picks them up
    local playerObj = Player[color]
    if not playerObj then
      print("Player object not found for color: " .. playerColor)
      return
    end
    local objs = playerObj.getSelectedObjects()

    -- For each object, rotate by the specified amount
    for _, obj in ipairs(objs) do
        local currentRotation = obj.getRotation()
        obj.setRotation({
            currentRotation[1],
            currentRotation[2] + rotationIncrement,  -- Apply the rotation increment here
            currentRotation[3]
        })
    end
end

local groupBRed = {"ab9a21", "ad19a7", "ca12da"}

function toggleActionTokens(state, color)
    -- Toggle between showing groupA and groupB.
    -- state == true  -> Show groupA (y=1) and hide groupB (under table).
    -- state == false -> Show groupB (y=1) and hide groupA (under table).
    local groupA, groupB
    if color == "Blue" then
        groupA = groupABlue
        groupB = groupBBlue
    else
        groupA = groupARed
        groupB = groupBRed
    end

    for _, g in ipairs(groupA) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            if state then
                -- show groupA
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], 1, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(false)
                o.interactable = true
            else
                -- hide groupA under the table
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(true)
                o.interactable = false
            end
        else
            print('GroupA object not found: ' .. g)
        end
    end

    for _, g in ipairs(groupB) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            if state then
                -- hide groupB under the table
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(true)
                o.interactable = false
            else
                -- show groupB
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], 1, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(false)
                o.interactable = true
            end
        else
            print('GroupB object not found: ' .. g)
        end
    end
end

function onLoad(saved_data)
    print("Control Panel script loaded")
    math.randomseed(os.time())
    loadCustomCounterState(saved_data)

    buildControlPanel("Red")
    buildControlPanel("Blue")

    -- Capture original positions for Action Token groups so restores use them
    for _, g in ipairs(groupARed) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupBRed) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupABlue) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupBBlue) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end

    toggleActionTokens(true, "Red")

    -- Hide the removed action token icons under the table
    for _, g in ipairs(removedActionTokens) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
            o.setLock(true)
            o.interactable = false
        end
    end

    -- Initialize board-linked objects.
    -- Keep dice mats visible on load; option-controlled helper objects must
    -- match their starting button state so locked chips are not left visible.
    for color, board in pairs(boards) do
        local diceMatGUID = resolveDiceMatGUID(color, board)
        board.DiceMat_GUID = diceMatGUID

        local diceMat = diceMatGUID and getObjectFromGUID(diceMatGUID) or nil
        if diceMat then
            if not originalPositions[diceMatGUID] then
                originalPositions[diceMatGUID] = diceMat.getPosition()
            end
        else
            print(color .. " Dice mat object not found during onLoad")
        end

        for _, option in ipairs(board.options) do
            if option.name == "Stat Helper" then
                toggleObjectState(board.StatHelper_GUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
            elseif option.name == "Custom Counter" then
                positionCustomCounters(color)
            elseif option.name == "Vortex" then
                toggleObjectState(board.VortexGUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
            end
        end
    end
end

local function normalizeUiString(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return value
    end
    local text = value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
    local quoted = text:match("^'(.*)'$")
    if quoted then
        return quoted
    end
    quoted = text:match('^"(.*)"$')
    if quoted then
        return quoted
    end
    return text
end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then

            displayName = nil,

local function getTrackingConsentButtonColors(status)
    if status == "accepted" then
        return "#77DD77|#66CC66|#55BB55"
    elseif status == "declined" then

    elseif status == "loading" then

local function resolveDiceMatGUID(color, board)
    local candidates = {}
    local seen = {}

    local function addCandidate(guid)
        if type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "" and not seen[guid] then
            seen[guid] = true
            table.insert(candidates, guid)
        end
    end

    if board then
        addCandidate(board.DiceMat_GUID)
    end

    if color == "Red" then
        addCandidate(Global.getVar("redCustomDiceMat_GUID"))
        addCandidate("c9d2b1") -- portrait red custom dice table
        addCandidate("acae21") -- legacy red custom dice table
        addCandidate("c57d70") -- legacy red dice mat
    else
        addCandidate(Global.getVar("blueCustomDiceMat_GUID"))
        addCandidate("d4e8a2") -- portrait blue custom dice table
        addCandidate("839fcc") -- legacy blue custom dice table
        addCandidate("a84ed2") -- legacy blue dice mat
    end

    for _, guid in ipairs(candidates) do
        if getObjectFromGUID(guid) then
            return guid
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)

local function getBoardColorFromArgs(...)

local function getCoord(pos, index, key)
    if type(pos) ~= "table" and type(pos) ~= "userdata" then return 0 end
    return pos[index] or pos[key] or 0
end

local function getCustomCounterOption(color)

    for index, option in ipairs(board.options) do

        end
    end
    return nil, nil
end

local function pruneCustomCounterExtras(color)
    local live = {}
    for _, guid in ipairs(customCounterExtras[color] or {}) do
        if type(guid) == "string" and guid ~= "" and getObjectFromGUID(guid) then
            table.insert(live, guid)
        end
    end
    customCounterExtras[color] = live
    return live
end

    local _, optionIndex = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not optionIndex then return end

    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local offColor = "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC"
    pcall(function()
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_status_" .. tostring(optionIndex), {
            text = state and "ON" or "OFF",
            colors = state and onColor or offColor,
        })
    end)
end

local function getCustomCounterPosition(color, index)
    local board = boards[color]
    local option = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not board or not option then return {0, 1, 0} end

    local base = getObjectFromGUID(board.CustomCounter)
    if base and not originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] then
        originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] = base.getPosition()
    end

    local basePos = originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] or (base and base.getPosition()) or {0, 1, 0}
    local visibleY = option.customHiddenPosition or getCoord(basePos, 2, "y")
    if type(visibleY) == "table" then
        visibleY = visibleY[2] or visibleY.y or getCoord(basePos, 2, "y")
    end

    local direction = (color == "Blue") and 1 or -1
    return {
        getCoord(basePos, 1, "x") + (direction * CUSTOM_COUNTER_SPACING * index),
        visibleY,
        getCoord(basePos, 3, "z"),
    }
end

local function hideCustomCounterObject(guid)
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not obj then return end
    if not originalPositions[guid] then
        originalPositions[guid] = obj.getPosition()
    end
    local pos = originalPositions[guid]
    obj.setPosition({
        getCoord(pos, 1, "x"),
        getCoord(pos, 2, "y") - 3,
        getCoord(pos, 3, "z"),
    })
    obj.setLock(true)
    obj.interactable = false
end

local function setCustomCounterObjectVisible(guid, position)
    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    if not obj then return end
    if not originalPositions[guid] then
        originalPositions[guid] = obj.getPosition()
    end
    obj.setPosition(position)
    obj.setLock(true)
    obj.interactable = true
end

local function positionCustomCounters(color)
    local board = boards[color]
    local option = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not board or not option then return end

    local extras = pruneCustomCounterExtras(color)
    if option.state then
        setCustomCounterObjectVisible(board.CustomCounter, getCustomCounterPosition(color, 0))
        for index, guid in ipairs(extras) do
            setCustomCounterObjectVisible(guid, getCustomCounterPosition(color, index))
        end
    else
        hideCustomCounterObject(board.CustomCounter)
        for _, guid in ipairs(extras) do
            hideCustomCounterObject(guid)
        end
    end
end

local function setCustomCounterEnabled(color, state)
    local option = getCustomCounterOption(color)
    if not option then return end
    option.state = state and true or false
    setCustomCounterStatusUi(color, option.state)
    positionCustomCounters(color)
end

function toggleObjectState(objectGUID, state, customHiddenPosition)
    if type(objectGUID) ~= "string" or objectGUID == "" then
        print("toggleObjectState called with invalid GUID")
        return
    end

    local obj = getObjectFromGUID(objectGUID)
    if obj then
        if not originalPositions[objectGUID] then
            originalPositions[objectGUID] = obj.getPosition()
        end

        if state then
            local newPosition
            if type(customHiddenPosition) == "table" then
                newPosition = {
                    customHiddenPosition[1] or originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                    customHiddenPosition[2] or originalPositions[objectGUID][2],
                    customHiddenPosition[3] or originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
                }
            else
                newPosition = {
                    originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                    (customHiddenPosition or originalPositions[objectGUID][2]),
                    originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
                }
            end

            obj.setPosition(newPosition)
            obj.setLock(true)
            obj.interactable = true
        else
            local hiddenPosition = {
                originalPositions[objectGUID][1],
                originalPositions[objectGUID][2] - 3,
                originalPositions[objectGUID][3]
            }
            obj.setPosition(hiddenPosition)
            obj.setLock(true)
            obj.interactable = false
        end
    else
        print("Object not found: " .. objectGUID)
    end
end

function addCustomCounter(...)
    local expectedColor = getBoardColorFromArgs(...)
    local playerColor = getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local board = boards[expectedColor]
    if not board then return end

    local base = getObjectFromGUID(board.CustomCounter)
    if not base then
        print(expectedColor .. " custom counter not found")
        return
    end

    if not originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] then
        originalPositions[board.CustomCounter] = base.getPosition()
    end

    setCustomCounterEnabled(expectedColor, true)

    local spawnIndex = #pruneCustomCounterExtras(expectedColor) + 1
    local clone = base.clone({
        position = getCustomCounterPosition(expectedColor, spawnIndex),
        snap_to_grid = false,
    })
    if not clone then return end

    local tint = randomCustomCounterTint()
    clone.setColorTint({tint[1], tint[2], tint[3]})
    clone.setLock(true)
    clone.interactable = true
    if clone.setDescription then
        clone.setDescription(expectedColor)
    end

    table.insert(customCounterExtras[expectedColor], clone.getGUID())

    Wait.frames(function()
        pcall(function() clone.call("setValue", 0) end)
        positionCustomCounters(expectedColor)
    end, 2)
end

function removeCustomCounter(...)
    local expectedColor = getBoardColorFromArgs(...)
    local playerColor = getPlayerColorFromArgs(...)

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local extras = pruneCustomCounterExtras(expectedColor)
    local guid = table.remove(extras)
    customCounterExtras[expectedColor] = extras

    if guid then
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then
            obj.destruct()
        end
    end

    positionCustomCounters(expectedColor)
end

function refreshTrackingConsent(player, color)
    local expectedColor = color
    if expectedColor ~= "Red" and expectedColor ~= "Blue" then
        expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"
    end

    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == "table" and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    end
    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        print("Start menu not found")
        return
    end

    setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "loading", "Checking...")

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        startMenu.call("refreshTrackedConsentStatusForSide", expectedColor)
    end)
    if not ok then
        print("Failed to refresh tracking consent: " .. tostring(err))
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "error", "Check failed")
        return
    end

    Wait.time(function()
        buildControlPanel(expectedColor)
    end, 0.2)
end

function chooseTrackingConsent(player, decision, color)
    local chosenDecision = nil
    local expectedColor = nil

    if type(player) == "string" and (player == "accepted" or player == "declined") then
        chosenDecision = player
        expectedColor = decision
    else
        chosenDecision = decision
        expectedColor = color
    end
    chosenDecision = normalizeUiString(chosenDecision)
    expectedColor = normalizeUiString(expectedColor)
    if expectedColor ~= "Red" and expectedColor ~= "Blue" then
        expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"
    end

    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == "table" and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    elseif type(decision) == "table" and decision.color then
        playerColor = decision.color
    elseif type(color) == "table" and color.color then
        playerColor = color.color
    end
    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local startMenu = getStartMenuObject()
    if not startMenu then
        print("Start menu not found")
        return
    end

    if chosenDecision == "accepted" or chosenDecision == "declined" then
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "loading", "Loading...")
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return startMenu.call("recordTrackedConsentChoice", {
            side = expectedColor,
            decision = chosenDecision,
        })
    end)
    if not ok then
        print("Failed to save consent: " .. tostring(result))
        setTrackingConsentStatusUi(expectedColor, "error", "Save failed")
        return
    end

    if result == false then

    end
