function toggleOption(player, index, color)
    -- Be tolerant of multiple calling styles from the UI:
    -- 1) toggleOption(Player, idx, 'Red')
    -- 2) toggleOption(idx, 'Red')  (TTS may inject Player automatically)
    -- debug prints removed

    -- Normalize index
    local idx = tonumber(index) or tonumber(player) or tonumber(color)
    if not idx then
        print("toggleOption: could not determine index from arguments")
        return
    end

    -- Determine expected board color (the board the script is on)
    local expectedColor = (self.getGUID() == "32ed4c") and "Red" or "Blue"

    -- Determine player color if available for access control
    local playerColor = nil
    if type(player) == 'table' and player.color then
        playerColor = player.color
    elseif type(index) == 'table' and index.color then
        playerColor = index.color
    elseif type(color) == 'table' and color.color then
        playerColor = color.color
    end

    if playerColor and playerColor ~= expectedColor then
        print("Access denied: " .. tostring(playerColor) .. " tried to use the " .. expectedColor .. " control board.")
        return
    end

    local board = boards[expectedColor]
    local option = board.options[tonumber(idx)]
    if not option then
        print("toggleOption: option not found for index: " .. tostring(idx))
        return
    end
    -- Flip the state (on/off).
    option.state = not option.state

    local statusId = expectedColor .. "_status_" .. tostring(idx)
    local newText = option.state and "ON" or "OFF"

    -- Pastel color repeated 4 times: normal|hover|pressed|disabled
    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local offColor = "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC"
    local newColors = option.state and onColor or offColor

    -- Update the button's text and the multi-state color attribute.
    self.UI.setAttributes(statusId, {
        text   = newText,
        colors = newColors
    })

    -- Then do your logic for each option name:
    if option.name == "Stat Helper" then
        toggleObjectState(board.StatHelper_GUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
    elseif option.name == "Dice Roller" then
        board.DiceMat_GUID = resolveDiceMatGUID(expectedColor, board)
        toggleObjectState(board.DiceMat_GUID, option.state)
    elseif option.name == "Vortex" then
        toggleObjectState(board.VortexGUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
    elseif option.name == "Hide Hutber" then
        Global.setVar(board.lethalFace, option.state and true or false)
    elseif option.name == "Custom Counter" then
        setCustomCounterEnabled(expectedColor, option.state)
    elseif option.name == "Turn Tracker" then
        Global.call("setHudVisibilityForColor", {color = expectedColor, visible = option.state})
    elseif option.name == "Rotation 5 Degrees" then
        toggleRotationAngle(board.CustomCounter, option.state)
    end
end

local rotationAngleState = 15  -- default is 15 degrees
local rotationIncrement = 5    -- Rotation increment when the angle is toggled to "on"

function toggleRotationAngle(color)
    -- Toggle between 15 and 5 degrees.
    if rotationAngleState == 15 then
        rotationAngleState = 5
    else
        rotationAngleState = 15
    end

    -- Update the status button text.
    local statusId = color .. "_status_rotation"
    local newText = rotationAngleState .. " Degrees"

    -- Pastel color for status button
    local onColor  = "#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77|#77DD77"
    local newColors = rotationAngleState == 5 and "#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC|#FFCCCC" or onColor

    -- Update the button's text and the multi-state color attribute.
    self.UI.setAttributes(statusId, {
        text   = newText,
        colors = newColors
    })

    -- Apply the new rotation behavior to all selected objects when the player picks them up
    local playerObj = Player[color]
    if not playerObj then
      print("Player object not found for color: " .. playerColor)
      return
    end
    local objs = playerObj.getSelectedObjects()

    -- For each object, rotate by the specified amount
    for _, obj in ipairs(objs) do
        local currentRotation = obj.getRotation()
        obj.setRotation({
            currentRotation[1],
            currentRotation[2] + rotationIncrement,  -- Apply the rotation increment here
            currentRotation[3]
        })
    end
end


-- Group definitions
local groupBRed = {"ab9a21", "ad19a7", "ca12da"}
local groupBBlue = {"3b0476", "a09c4e", "ae9056"}
local groupARed = {}
local groupABlue = {}

-- Action token icons removed from the table (hidden under the table on load)
local removedActionTokens = {"1c0491", "98e221", "21aa0e", "8a7d71", "aba7a1", "9b9a9a"}

function toggleActionTokens(state, color)
    -- Toggle between showing groupA and groupB.
    -- state == true  -> Show groupA (y=1) and hide groupB (under table).
    -- state == false -> Show groupB (y=1) and hide groupA (under table).
    local groupA, groupB
    if color == "Blue" then
        groupA = groupABlue
        groupB = groupBBlue
    else
        groupA = groupARed
        groupB = groupBRed
    end

    for _, g in ipairs(groupA) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            if state then
                -- show groupA
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], 1, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(false)
                o.interactable = true
            else
                -- hide groupA under the table
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(true)
                o.interactable = false
            end
        else
            print('GroupA object not found: ' .. g)
        end
    end

    for _, g in ipairs(groupB) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            if state then
                -- hide groupB under the table
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(true)
                o.interactable = false
            else
                -- show groupB
                o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], 1, originalPositions[g][3] })
                o.setLock(false)
                o.interactable = true
            end
        else
            print('GroupB object not found: ' .. g)
        end
    end
end

function onLoad(saved_data)
    print("Control Panel script loaded")
    math.randomseed(os.time())
    loadCustomCounterState(saved_data)

    buildControlPanel("Red")
    buildControlPanel("Blue")

    -- Capture original positions for Action Token groups so restores use them
    for _, g in ipairs(groupARed) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupBRed) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupABlue) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end
    for _, g in ipairs(groupBBlue) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o and not originalPositions[g] then
            originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition()
        end
    end

    toggleActionTokens(true, "Red")

    -- Hide the removed action token icons under the table
    for _, g in ipairs(removedActionTokens) do
        local o = getObjectFromGUID(g)
        if o then
            if not originalPositions[g] then originalPositions[g] = o.getPosition() end
            o.setPosition({ originalPositions[g][1], originalPositions[g][2] - 3, originalPositions[g][3] })
            o.setLock(true)
            o.interactable = false
        end
    end

    -- Initialize board-linked objects.
    -- Keep dice mats visible on load; option-controlled helper objects must
    -- match their starting button state so locked chips are not left visible.
    for color, board in pairs(boards) do
        local diceMatGUID = resolveDiceMatGUID(color, board)
        board.DiceMat_GUID = diceMatGUID

        local diceMat = diceMatGUID and getObjectFromGUID(diceMatGUID) or nil
        if diceMat then
            if not originalPositions[diceMatGUID] then
                originalPositions[diceMatGUID] = diceMat.getPosition()
            end
        else
            print(color .. " Dice mat object not found during onLoad")
        end

        for _, option in ipairs(board.options) do
            if option.name == "Stat Helper" then
                toggleObjectState(board.StatHelper_GUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
            elseif option.name == "Custom Counter" then
                positionCustomCounters(color)
            elseif option.name == "Vortex" then
                toggleObjectState(board.VortexGUID, option.state, option.customHiddenPosition)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Shared "Clean Counters" token base (originally by GBee, MIT).
-- Included by counter.ttslua, turns.ttslua and gameRounds.ttslua so every token
-- counter shares the same display + value handling.
--
-- Including scripts must:
--   * call cleanCounterInit(save_state) from their onLoad
--   * return cleanCounterSave() from their onSave
-- and may optionally define onCleanCounterChanged(value) to react to changes
-- (HUD sync, round transitions, etc.).
--
-- The value API (getValue/setValue/increment/decrement) is exposed as global
-- functions so other objects can drive the counter via obj.call("increment")
-- etc. -- see includes/counterAccess.lua for the polymorphic wrappers.

FONT_COLOR_LIGHT = {1, 1, 1, 100}
FONT_COLOR_DARK  = {0, 0, 0, 100}
FONT_SIZE        = 750
FONT_SIZE_SMALL  = 500
VALUE_POS        = {0, 0.1, -0.45}
VALUE_POS_SMALL  = {0, 0.1, -0.2}
TRANSPARENT      = {0, 0, 0, 0}

script_state = nil

function cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    if save_state == nil or save_state == "" then
        script_state = {
            value = 0,
            label = "Token",
            use_prefix = false,
            light_font = true,
        }
    else
        script_state = JSON.decode(save_state)
        if script_state.light_font == nil then script_state.light_font = true end
    end
    createUserInterface()
end

function cleanCounterSave()
    return JSON.encode(script_state)
end

function createUserInterface()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        tooltip        = "+/-",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 0.1, 1},
        height         = 600,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = 250,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
    })
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = script_state.value,
        position       = VALUE_POS,
        height         = 800,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = FONT_SIZE,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
        font_color     = FONT_COLOR_DARK,
    })
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Prefix", togglePrefix, false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Font Color", toggleFont, false)
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function togglePrefix()
    script_state.use_prefix = not script_state.use_prefix
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function toggleFont()
    script_state.light_font = not script_state.light_font
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function onIncrementDecrementClick(obj, color, alt)
    -- Read-only counters (e.g. Victory Points) are driven only by other scripts
    -- via setValue; clicking them does nothing.
    if script_state.readonly then return end
    local oldValue = script_state.value
    if alt then
        script_state.value = script_state.value - 1
    else
        script_state.value = script_state.value + 1
    end
    refreshTokenUI()
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, color)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

-- ===== External value API (callable via obj.call) =====
function getValue()
    return (script_state and script_state.value) or 0
end

function setValue(v)
    if not script_state then return end
    script_state.value = tonumber(v) or 0
    refreshTokenUI()
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function increment()
    setValue(getValue() + 1)
end

function decrement()
    setValue(getValue() - 1)
end

function incrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(1, params)
end

function decrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(-1, params)
end

function changeValueWithActor(delta, params)
    if not script_state then return end
    local oldValue = getValue()
    script_state.value = oldValue + delta
    refreshTokenUI()
    local actorColor = nil
    if type(params) == "table" then
        actorColor = params.actorColor or params.color or params.playerColor
    elseif type(params) == "string" then
        actorColor = params
    end
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, actorColor)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function isCommandPointCounter()
    local guid = self.getGUID()
    if guid == "e446f7" or guid == "deb9f2" then return true end
    local label = self.getName() or ""
    return label:find("Command Points", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function playerDisplayName(color)
    if not color or color == "" then return "Unknown player" end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        return Player[color] and Player[color].steam_name
    end)
    if ok and name and name ~= "" then
        return name .. " (" .. color .. ")"
    end
    return color
end

function logCommandPointChange(oldValue, newValue, actorColor)
    if oldValue == newValue or not isCommandPointCounter() then return end
    local action = newValue > oldValue and "increased" or "decreased"
    local label = self.getName() or "Command Points"
    broadcastToAll(
        playerDisplayName(actorColor) .. " " .. action .. " " .. label ..
        " from " .. tostring(oldValue) .. " to " .. tostring(newValue) .. ".",
        {1, 0.85, 0.2}
    )
end

function notifyCleanCounterChanged()
    if onCleanCounterChanged then
        onCleanCounterChanged(script_state.value)
    end
end

-- Wrap a long label onto two lines, breaking at the space nearest the middle so
-- the two lines are roughly balanced. Short labels are left untouched.
function wrapLabelTwoLines(label)
    if not label or #label <= 16 or label:find("\n") then
        return label
    end
    local mid = #label / 2
    local bestPos, bestDist
    for i = 1, #label do
        if label:sub(i, i) == " " then
            local dist = math.abs(i - mid)
            if not bestDist or dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                bestPos = i
            end
        end
    end
    if not bestPos then return label end
    return label:sub(1, bestPos - 1) .. "\n" .. label:sub(bestPos + 1)
end

function refreshTokenUI()
    script_state.label = self.getName()
    local display_font_size = FONT_SIZE
    local display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        if math.abs(script_state.value) > 99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    else
        if script_state.value > 999 or script_state.value < -99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    end
    local display_font_color = script_state.light_font and FONT_COLOR_LIGHT or FONT_COLOR_DARK
    local display_value = tostring(script_state.value)
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        display_value = (script_state.value >= 0 and "+" or "") .. tostring(script_state.value)
    end
    self.editButton({
        index      = 0,
        label      = wrapLabelTwoLines(script_state.label),
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
    self.editButton({
        index      = 1,
        label      = display_value,
        font_size  = display_font_size,
        position   = display_value_pos,
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
end
-- END include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
--
-- Token "Clean Counters" used for the CP / VP / spare counters. All display and
-- value logic lives in includes/cleanCounter.lua; this just wires the object
-- lifecycle to it.

function onLoad(save_state)
    cleanCounterInit(save_state)
end

function onSave()
    return cleanCounterSave()
end

-- BEGIN include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
-- Shared "Clean Counters" token base (originally by GBee, MIT).
-- Included by counter.ttslua, turns.ttslua and gameRounds.ttslua so every token
-- counter shares the same display + value handling.
--
-- Including scripts must:
--   * call cleanCounterInit(save_state) from their onLoad
--   * return cleanCounterSave() from their onSave
-- and may optionally define onCleanCounterChanged(value) to react to changes
-- (HUD sync, round transitions, etc.).
--
-- The value API (getValue/setValue/increment/decrement) is exposed as global
-- functions so other objects can drive the counter via obj.call("increment")
-- etc. -- see includes/counterAccess.lua for the polymorphic wrappers.

FONT_COLOR_LIGHT = {1, 1, 1, 100}
FONT_COLOR_DARK  = {0, 0, 0, 100}
FONT_SIZE        = 750
FONT_SIZE_SMALL  = 500
VALUE_POS        = {0, 0.1, -0.45}
VALUE_POS_SMALL  = {0, 0.1, -0.2}
TRANSPARENT      = {0, 0, 0, 0}

script_state = nil

function cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    if save_state == nil or save_state == "" then
        script_state = {
            value = 0,
            label = "Token",
            use_prefix = false,
            light_font = true,
        }
    else
        script_state = JSON.decode(save_state)
        if script_state.light_font == nil then script_state.light_font = true end
    end
    createUserInterface()
end

function cleanCounterSave()
    return JSON.encode(script_state)
end

function createUserInterface()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        tooltip        = "+/-",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 0.1, 1},
        height         = 600,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = 250,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
    })
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = script_state.value,
        position       = VALUE_POS,
        height         = 800,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = FONT_SIZE,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
        font_color     = FONT_COLOR_DARK,
    })
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Prefix", togglePrefix, false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Font Color", toggleFont, false)
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function togglePrefix()
    script_state.use_prefix = not script_state.use_prefix
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function toggleFont()
    script_state.light_font = not script_state.light_font
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function onIncrementDecrementClick(obj, color, alt)
    -- Read-only counters (e.g. Victory Points) are driven only by other scripts
    -- via setValue; clicking them does nothing.
    if script_state.readonly then return end
    local oldValue = script_state.value
    if alt then
        script_state.value = script_state.value - 1
    else
        script_state.value = script_state.value + 1
    end
    refreshTokenUI()
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, color)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

-- ===== External value API (callable via obj.call) =====
function getValue()
    return (script_state and script_state.value) or 0
end

function setValue(v)
    if not script_state then return end
    script_state.value = tonumber(v) or 0
    refreshTokenUI()
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function increment()
    setValue(getValue() + 1)
end

function decrement()
    setValue(getValue() - 1)
end

function incrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(1, params)
end

function decrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(-1, params)
end

function changeValueWithActor(delta, params)
    if not script_state then return end
    local oldValue = getValue()
    script_state.value = oldValue + delta
    refreshTokenUI()
    local actorColor = nil
    if type(params) == "table" then
        actorColor = params.actorColor or params.color or params.playerColor
    elseif type(params) == "string" then
        actorColor = params
    end
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, actorColor)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function isCommandPointCounter()
    local guid = self.getGUID()
    if guid == "e446f7" or guid == "deb9f2" then return true end
    local label = self.getName() or ""
    return label:find("Command Points", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function playerDisplayName(color)
    if not color or color == "" then return "Unknown player" end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        return Player[color] and Player[color].steam_name
    end)
    if ok and name and name ~= "" then
        return name .. " (" .. color .. ")"
    end
    return color
end

function logCommandPointChange(oldValue, newValue, actorColor)
    if oldValue == newValue or not isCommandPointCounter() then return end
    local action = newValue > oldValue and "increased" or "decreased"
    local label = self.getName() or "Command Points"
    broadcastToAll(
        playerDisplayName(actorColor) .. " " .. action .. " " .. label ..
        " from " .. tostring(oldValue) .. " to " .. tostring(newValue) .. ".",
        {1, 0.85, 0.2}
    )
end

function notifyCleanCounterChanged()
    if onCleanCounterChanged then
        onCleanCounterChanged(script_state.value)
    end
end

-- Wrap a long label onto two lines, breaking at the space nearest the middle so
-- the two lines are roughly balanced. Short labels are left untouched.
function wrapLabelTwoLines(label)
    if not label or #label <= 16 or label:find("\n") then
        return label
    end
    local mid = #label / 2
    local bestPos, bestDist
    for i = 1, #label do
        if label:sub(i, i) == " " then
            local dist = math.abs(i - mid)
            if not bestDist or dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                bestPos = i
            end
        end
    end
    if not bestPos then return label end
    return label:sub(1, bestPos - 1) .. "\n" .. label:sub(bestPos + 1)
end

function refreshTokenUI()
    script_state.label = self.getName()
    local display_font_size = FONT_SIZE
    local display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        if math.abs(script_state.value) > 99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    else
        if script_state.value > 999 or script_state.value < -99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    end
    local display_font_color = script_state.light_font and FONT_COLOR_LIGHT or FONT_COLOR_DARK
    local display_value = tostring(script_state.value)
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        display_value = (script_state.value >= 0 and "+" or "") .. tostring(script_state.value)
    end
    self.editButton({
        index      = 0,
        label      = wrapLabelTwoLines(script_state.label),
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
    self.editButton({
        index      = 1,
        label      = display_value,
        font_size  = display_font_size,
        position   = display_value_pos,
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
end
-- END include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
--
-- Token "Clean Counters" used for the CP / VP / spare counters. All display and
-- value logic lives in includes/cleanCounter.lua; this just wires the object
-- lifecycle to it.

function onLoad(save_state)
    cleanCounterInit(save_state)
end

function onSave()
    return cleanCounterSave()
end

-- BEGIN include: includes/counterAccess.lua
-- Polymorphic counter access. Works for both TTS built-in Counter objects and
-- the token "Clean Counters" (which expose getValue/increment/etc. via
-- includes/cleanCounter.lua). Lets caller code treat either kind the same way,
-- so swapping a counter's type does not require touching every call site.

function counterValue(obj)
    if not obj then return 0 end
    if obj.Counter then return obj.Counter.getValue() end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj.call("getValue") end)
    if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
    return 0
end

function counterSetValue(obj, v)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.setValue(v)
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("setValue", v) end)
    end
end

function counterIncrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.increment()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("increment") end)
    end
end

function counterDecrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.decrement()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("decrement") end)
    end
end
-- END include: includes/counterAccess.lua

function onLoad(save_state)
    startObject = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("startMenu_GUID"))
    scoreSheet  = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("scoreSheet_GUID"))
    cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    updateHUD()
end

function onSave()
    return cleanCounterSave()
end

-- Fired by cleanCounter whenever the round value changes.
function onCleanCounterChanged(value)
    updateHUD()
    if startObject then
        startObject.call("newRoundStarted")
    end
    if value == 6 then
        broadcastToAll("GAME OVER - feel free to continue playing!", "Yellow")
    end
end

function updateHUD()
    Global.call("setHudValue", {id = "RoundWatch", value = tostring(getValue())})
end

-- Called externally by the start menu.
function checkGameEnd()
    updateHUD()
    if getValue() == 6 then
        broadcastToAll("GAME OVER - feel free to continue playing!", "Yellow")
    end
end

function gameOver()
    startObject.setVar("checkEnd", false)
    startObject.call("writeMenus")
    local scoreA = scoreSheet.call("playerSum", {1})
    local scoreB = scoreSheet.call("playerSum", {2})
    if scoreA > scoreB then
        broadcastToAll("Red Player WINS !", "Green")
    elseif scoreA < scoreB then
        broadcastToAll("Blue Player WINS !", "Green")
    else
        broadcastToAll("Game ends in a DRAW !", "Green")
    end
end

function gameContinues()
    startObject.setVar("checkEnd", false)
    startObject.call("writeMenus")
end

-- FTC-GUID: 7e4111,055302
-- Token turn counters (Player A / Player B Turn). The object Description holds
-- the GUID of the game-round counter, used to bump the round when a player's
-- turn passes the current round.
-- BEGIN include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
-- Shared "Clean Counters" token base (originally by GBee, MIT).
-- Included by counter.ttslua, turns.ttslua and gameRounds.ttslua so every token
-- counter shares the same display + value handling.
--
-- Including scripts must:
--   * call cleanCounterInit(save_state) from their onLoad
--   * return cleanCounterSave() from their onSave
-- and may optionally define onCleanCounterChanged(value) to react to changes
-- (HUD sync, round transitions, etc.).
--
-- The value API (getValue/setValue/increment/decrement) is exposed as global
-- functions so other objects can drive the counter via obj.call("increment")
-- etc. -- see includes/counterAccess.lua for the polymorphic wrappers.

FONT_COLOR_LIGHT = {1, 1, 1, 100}
FONT_COLOR_DARK  = {0, 0, 0, 100}
FONT_SIZE        = 750
FONT_SIZE_SMALL  = 500
VALUE_POS        = {0, 0.1, -0.45}
VALUE_POS_SMALL  = {0, 0.1, -0.2}
TRANSPARENT      = {0, 0, 0, 0}

script_state = nil

function cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    if save_state == nil or save_state == "" then
        script_state = {
            value = 0,
            label = "Token",
            use_prefix = false,
            light_font = true,
        }
    else
        script_state = JSON.decode(save_state)
        if script_state.light_font == nil then script_state.light_font = true end
    end
    createUserInterface()
end

function cleanCounterSave()
    return JSON.encode(script_state)
end

function createUserInterface()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        tooltip        = "+/-",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 0.1, 1},
        height         = 600,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = 250,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
    })
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = script_state.value,
        position       = VALUE_POS,
        height         = 800,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = FONT_SIZE,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
        font_color     = FONT_COLOR_DARK,
    })
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Prefix", togglePrefix, false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Font Color", toggleFont, false)
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function togglePrefix()
    script_state.use_prefix = not script_state.use_prefix
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function toggleFont()
    script_state.light_font = not script_state.light_font
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function onIncrementDecrementClick(obj, color, alt)
    -- Read-only counters (e.g. Victory Points) are driven only by other scripts
    -- via setValue; clicking them does nothing.
    if script_state.readonly then return end
    local oldValue = script_state.value
    if alt then
        script_state.value = script_state.value - 1
    else
        script_state.value = script_state.value + 1
    end
    refreshTokenUI()
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, color)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

-- ===== External value API (callable via obj.call) =====
function getValue()
    return (script_state and script_state.value) or 0
end

function setValue(v)
    if not script_state then return end
    script_state.value = tonumber(v) or 0
    refreshTokenUI()
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function increment()
    setValue(getValue() + 1)
end

function decrement()
    setValue(getValue() - 1)
end

function incrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(1, params)
end

function decrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(-1, params)
end

function changeValueWithActor(delta, params)
    if not script_state then return end
    local oldValue = getValue()
    script_state.value = oldValue + delta
    refreshTokenUI()
    local actorColor = nil
    if type(params) == "table" then
        actorColor = params.actorColor or params.color or params.playerColor
    elseif type(params) == "string" then
        actorColor = params
    end
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, actorColor)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function isCommandPointCounter()
    local guid = self.getGUID()
    if guid == "e446f7" or guid == "deb9f2" then return true end
    local label = self.getName() or ""
    return label:find("Command Points", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function playerDisplayName(color)
    if not color or color == "" then return "Unknown player" end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        return Player[color] and Player[color].steam_name
    end)
    if ok and name and name ~= "" then
        return name .. " (" .. color .. ")"
    end
    return color
end

function logCommandPointChange(oldValue, newValue, actorColor)
    if oldValue == newValue or not isCommandPointCounter() then return end
    local action = newValue > oldValue and "increased" or "decreased"
    local label = self.getName() or "Command Points"
    broadcastToAll(
        playerDisplayName(actorColor) .. " " .. action .. " " .. label ..
        " from " .. tostring(oldValue) .. " to " .. tostring(newValue) .. ".",
        {1, 0.85, 0.2}
    )
end

function notifyCleanCounterChanged()
    if onCleanCounterChanged then
        onCleanCounterChanged(script_state.value)
    end
end

-- Wrap a long label onto two lines, breaking at the space nearest the middle so
-- the two lines are roughly balanced. Short labels are left untouched.
function wrapLabelTwoLines(label)
    if not label or #label <= 16 or label:find("\n") then
        return label
    end
    local mid = #label / 2
    local bestPos, bestDist
    for i = 1, #label do
        if label:sub(i, i) == " " then
            local dist = math.abs(i - mid)
            if not bestDist or dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                bestPos = i
            end
        end
    end
    if not bestPos then return label end
    return label:sub(1, bestPos - 1) .. "\n" .. label:sub(bestPos + 1)
end

function refreshTokenUI()
    script_state.label = self.getName()
    local display_font_size = FONT_SIZE
    local display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        if math.abs(script_state.value) > 99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    else
        if script_state.value > 999 or script_state.value < -99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    end
    local display_font_color = script_state.light_font and FONT_COLOR_LIGHT or FONT_COLOR_DARK
    local display_value = tostring(script_state.value)
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        display_value = (script_state.value >= 0 and "+" or "") .. tostring(script_state.value)
    end
    self.editButton({
        index      = 0,
        label      = wrapLabelTwoLines(script_state.label),
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
    self.editButton({
        index      = 1,
        label      = display_value,
        font_size  = display_font_size,
        position   = display_value_pos,
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
end
-- END include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
-- BEGIN include: includes/counterAccess.lua
-- Polymorphic counter access. Works for both TTS built-in Counter objects and
-- the token "Clean Counters" (which expose getValue/increment/etc. via
-- includes/cleanCounter.lua). Lets caller code treat either kind the same way,
-- so swapping a counter's type does not require touching every call site.

function counterValue(obj)
    if not obj then return 0 end
    if obj.Counter then return obj.Counter.getValue() end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj.call("getValue") end)
    if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
    return 0
end

function counterSetValue(obj, v)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.setValue(v)
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("setValue", v) end)
    end
end

function counterIncrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.increment()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("increment") end)
    end
end

function counterDecrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.decrement()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("decrement") end)
    end
end
-- END include: includes/counterAccess.lua

local _watchId = nil

function onLoad(save_state)
    cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    _watchId = (self.getGUID() == "7e4111") and "TVWatch1" or "TVWatch2"
    updateHUD()
end

function onSave()
    return cleanCounterSave()
end

-- Fired by cleanCounter whenever the value changes (player click or external call).
function onCleanCounterChanged(value)
    updateHUD()
    gameUpdate()
end

function updateHUD()
    Global.call("setHudAttribute", {id = _watchId, attr = "text", value = "Turn " .. getValue()})
end

-- Kept for compatibility with any external callers that bumped the turn counter.
function increaseSelf()
    increment()
end

function gameUpdate()
    local gameTurn = getObjectFromGUID(self.getDescription())
    local startMenu = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("startMenu_GUID"))

    if gameTurn == nil then return end

    if getValue() > counterValue(gameTurn) then
        counterSetValue(gameTurn, getValue())
        if startMenu then startMenu.call("newRoundStarted") end
    end
end

-- FTC-GUID: 42c164,42c161,e446f7,deb9f2,8b0541,a77a54
-- BEGIN include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
-- Shared "Clean Counters" token base (originally by GBee, MIT).
-- Included by counter.ttslua, turns.ttslua and gameRounds.ttslua so every token
-- counter shares the same display + value handling.
--
-- Including scripts must:
--   * call cleanCounterInit(save_state) from their onLoad
--   * return cleanCounterSave() from their onSave
-- and may optionally define onCleanCounterChanged(value) to react to changes
-- (HUD sync, round transitions, etc.).
--
-- The value API (getValue/setValue/increment/decrement) is exposed as global
-- functions so other objects can drive the counter via obj.call("increment")
-- etc. -- see includes/counterAccess.lua for the polymorphic wrappers.

FONT_COLOR_LIGHT = {1, 1, 1, 100}
FONT_COLOR_DARK  = {0, 0, 0, 100}
FONT_SIZE        = 750
FONT_SIZE_SMALL  = 500
VALUE_POS        = {0, 0.1, -0.45}
VALUE_POS_SMALL  = {0, 0.1, -0.2}
TRANSPARENT      = {0, 0, 0, 0}

script_state = nil

function cleanCounterInit(save_state)
    if save_state == nil or save_state == "" then
        script_state = {
            value = 0,
            label = "Token",
            use_prefix = false,
            light_font = true,
        }
    else
        script_state = JSON.decode(save_state)
        if script_state.light_font == nil then script_state.light_font = true end
    end
    createUserInterface()
end

function cleanCounterSave()
    return JSON.encode(script_state)
end

function createUserInterface()
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        tooltip        = "+/-",
        function_owner = self,
        position       = {0, 0.1, 1},
        height         = 600,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = 250,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
    })
    self.createButton({
        click_function = "onIncrementDecrementClick",
        function_owner = self,
        label          = script_state.value,
        position       = VALUE_POS,
        height         = 800,
        width          = 1500,
        font_size      = FONT_SIZE,
        color          = TRANSPARENT,
        font_color     = FONT_COLOR_DARK,
    })
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Prefix", togglePrefix, false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Font Color", toggleFont, false)
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function togglePrefix()
    script_state.use_prefix = not script_state.use_prefix
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function toggleFont()
    script_state.light_font = not script_state.light_font
    refreshTokenUI()
end

function onIncrementDecrementClick(obj, color, alt)
    -- Read-only counters (e.g. Victory Points) are driven only by other scripts
    -- via setValue; clicking them does nothing.
    if script_state.readonly then return end
    local oldValue = script_state.value
    if alt then
        script_state.value = script_state.value - 1
    else
        script_state.value = script_state.value + 1
    end
    refreshTokenUI()
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, color)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

-- ===== External value API (callable via obj.call) =====
function getValue()
    return (script_state and script_state.value) or 0
end

function setValue(v)
    if not script_state then return end
    script_state.value = tonumber(v) or 0
    refreshTokenUI()
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function increment()
    setValue(getValue() + 1)
end

function decrement()
    setValue(getValue() - 1)
end

function incrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(1, params)
end

function decrementWithActor(params)
    changeValueWithActor(-1, params)
end

function changeValueWithActor(delta, params)
    if not script_state then return end
    local oldValue = getValue()
    script_state.value = oldValue + delta
    refreshTokenUI()
    local actorColor = nil
    if type(params) == "table" then
        actorColor = params.actorColor or params.color or params.playerColor
    elseif type(params) == "string" then
        actorColor = params
    end
    logCommandPointChange(oldValue, script_state.value, actorColor)
    notifyCleanCounterChanged()
end

function isCommandPointCounter()
    local guid = self.getGUID()
    if guid == "e446f7" or guid == "deb9f2" then return true end
    local label = self.getName() or ""
    return label:find("Command Points", 1, true) ~= nil
end

function playerDisplayName(color)
    if not color or color == "" then return "Unknown player" end
    local ok, name = pcall(function()
        return Player[color] and Player[color].steam_name
    end)
    if ok and name and name ~= "" then
        return name .. " (" .. color .. ")"
    end
    return color
end

function logCommandPointChange(oldValue, newValue, actorColor)
    if oldValue == newValue or not isCommandPointCounter() then return end
    local action = newValue > oldValue and "increased" or "decreased"
    local label = self.getName() or "Command Points"
    broadcastToAll(
        playerDisplayName(actorColor) .. " " .. action .. " " .. label ..
        " from " .. tostring(oldValue) .. " to " .. tostring(newValue) .. ".",
        {1, 0.85, 0.2}
    )
end

function notifyCleanCounterChanged()
    if onCleanCounterChanged then
        onCleanCounterChanged(script_state.value)
    end
end

-- Wrap a long label onto two lines, breaking at the space nearest the middle so
-- the two lines are roughly balanced. Short labels are left untouched.
function wrapLabelTwoLines(label)
    if not label or #label <= 16 or label:find("\n") then
        return label
    end
    local mid = #label / 2
    local bestPos, bestDist
    for i = 1, #label do
        if label:sub(i, i) == " " then
            local dist = math.abs(i - mid)
            if not bestDist or dist < bestDist then
                bestDist = dist
                bestPos = i
            end
        end
    end
    if not bestPos then return label end
    return label:sub(1, bestPos - 1) .. "\n" .. label:sub(bestPos + 1)
end

function refreshTokenUI()
    script_state.label = self.getName()
    local display_font_size = FONT_SIZE
    local display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        if math.abs(script_state.value) > 99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    else
        if script_state.value > 999 or script_state.value < -99 then
            display_font_size = FONT_SIZE_SMALL
            display_value_pos  = VALUE_POS_SMALL
        end
    end
    local display_font_color = script_state.light_font and FONT_COLOR_LIGHT or FONT_COLOR_DARK
    local display_value = tostring(script_state.value)
    if script_state.use_prefix then
        display_value = (script_state.value >= 0 and "+" or "") .. tostring(script_state.value)
    end
    self.editButton({
        index      = 0,
        label      = wrapLabelTwoLines(script_state.label),
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
    self.editButton({
        index      = 1,
        label      = display_value,
        font_size  = display_font_size,
        position   = display_value_pos,
        font_color = display_font_color,
    })
end
-- END include: includes/cleanCounter.lua
--
-- Token "Clean Counters" used for the CP / VP / spare counters. All display and
-- value logic lives in includes/cleanCounter.lua; this just wires the object
-- lifecycle to it.

function onLoad(save_state)
    cleanCounterInit(save_state)
end

function onSave()
    return cleanCounterSave()
end

            if obj.getGMNotes() ~= "deployZone" and obj.getGMNotes() ~= "objective" then

                    unlockedTerrain[i] = obj
                end
            end
        end
    end

function mirrorTerrain()
    local lockedTerrain = {}
    local unlockedTerrain = {}

    lockedTerrain, unlockedTerrain = collectTerrainObjects()

    for i, obj in pairs(unlockedTerrain) do
        obj.destroy()
    end
    
    for i, obj in pairs(lockedTerrain) do
        local newPos = obj.getPosition()
        local newRot = obj.getRotation()

        newPos.x = -newPos.x
        newPos.z = -newPos.z
        newRot.y = newRot.y + 180

        -- object close to center aligned, mirror objects not at center.
        if math.abs(newPos.x) < 1 and math.abs(newPos.z) < 1 then
            obj.setPosition({0, newPos.y, 0})
        else
            local newObj = obj.clone({
                position=newPos,
                rotation=newRot
            })
            newObj.locked = false
        end
    end

    YNButtonsMirror = false
    writeMenu()
    broadcastToAll("DONE", "Red")
end

            newLua = addLua .. oldLua
            obj.setLuaScript(newLua)

function getHighlightColorForPlayer(playerColor)
    local colorMapping = {
        Red = {1, 0, 0}, -- Red
        Blue = {0, 0, 1}, -- Blue
        Green = {0, 1, 0}, -- Green
        Yellow = {1, 1, 0}, -- Yellow
        Purple = {0.5, 0, 0.5}, -- Purple

-- FTC-GUID: 738804
-- BEGIN include: includes/counterAccess.lua
-- Polymorphic counter access. Works for both TTS built-in Counter objects and
-- the token "Clean Counters" (which expose getValue/increment/etc. via
-- includes/cleanCounter.lua). Lets caller code treat either kind the same way,
-- so swapping a counter's type does not require touching every call site.

function counterValue(obj)
    if not obj then return 0 end
    if obj.Counter then return obj.Counter.getValue() end
    local ok, v = pcall(function() return obj.call("getValue") end)
    if ok and type(v) == "number" then return v end
    return 0
end

function counterSetValue(obj, v)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.setValue(v)
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("setValue", v) end)
    end
end

function counterIncrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.increment()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("increment") end)
    end
end

function counterDecrement(obj)
    if not obj then return end
    if obj.Counter then
        obj.Counter.decrement()
    else
        pcall(function() obj.call("decrement") end)
    end
end

    end

        for _, side in ipairs({"Red", "Blue"}) do
            local entry = trackedConsentStateBySide[side]

                entry.status = "unknown"
                entry.updatedAt = nil
            end
        end

function destroyObjectsByGuidMap(guidMap)
    for guid, _ in pairs(guidMap) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then
            destroyObject(obj)
        end
    end
end

function destroyObjectsByGuidList(guidList)
    for _, guid in ipairs(guidList) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then
            destroyObject(obj)
        end
    end
end

function setObjectHeightsByGuid(guidMap)
    for guid, newPosY in pairs(guidMap) do
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj then
            local position = obj.getPosition()
            position.y = newPosY
            obj.setPosition(position)
            obj.setLock(true)
        end
    end
end

-- Function called when the button is clicked
function onObjectClick(player_color, object_clicked)
    showMapsToggle = true
    destroyObjectsByGuidMap(mapSelectionHeights)
    destroyObjectsByGuidList(extraMapSelectionCleanupGuids)

    destroyMapSelectionButtonObject()
end

function destroyMapSelectionButtonObject()
    if spawnedObjectRef then
        destroyObject(spawnedObjectRef)
        spawnedObjectRef = nil
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj.getGMNotes and obj.getGMNotes() == "mapSelectionButton" then
            destroyObject(obj)
        end
    end
end

-- Function to set up click events for a spawned object
function setupClickEvents(spawnedObject)
    spawnedObject.setLock(true)
    spawnedObject.setGMNotes("mapSelectionButton")

    -- Save the reference to the spawned object
    spawnedObjectRef = spawnedObject

    -- Create the button
    spawnedObject.createButton({
        label = showMapsToggle and "Show Maps" or "Clear Map Selection",
        click_function = "onObjectClick",
        function_owner = self,
        position = {0, 3, -44},
        height = 800,
        width = 6500,
        font_size = 700,
        color = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5},
        font_color = {1, 1, 1},
    })
end

-- Function to spawn an interactive object
function spawnInteractiveObject()
    if inGame then return end
    destroyMapSelectionButtonObject()
    spawnObject({
        type = "BlockSquare",
        position = {0, -2, 0},
        scale = {1, 1, 1},
        rotation = {0, -90, 0},
        callback_function = function(spawnedObject)
            if spawnedObject then
                setupClickEvents(spawnedObject)
            else
                print("Failed to spawn object")
            end
        end
    })
end

function createCounter(position, label)

        type = "Counter",
        position = position,
        scale = {1, 1, 1},
    })
    counter.setName(label)
    counter.setValue(0)
    return counter

function shuffleAndDealTeamCards()
    local teamDeck = getObjectFromGUID(Global.getVar("teamDeck_GUID"))
    teamDeck.shuffle()
    local players = Player.getPlayers()
    for i, player in ipairs(players) do
        teamDeck.deal(1, player.color)
    end
    broadcastToAll("Teams have been randomized and dealt!", {0, 1, 0})
end


function placeGameTokens()
    local cardsTeams = getObjectFromGUID("c59f7a")
    cardsTeams.shuffle()
    broadcastToAll("Team cards have been shuffled! Safe to Draw.", {0, 1, 0})
    if cardsTeams then
        cardsTeams.setPosition({42, 0.9, 37})
        ttsDebugLog("cardsTeams new position: " .. tostring(cardsTeams.getPosition()))
    else
        ttsDebugLog("cardsTeams not found!")
    end

    local tokenBag = getObjectFromGUID("f8ddf5")
    if not tokenBag then
        broadcastToAll("Error: Token bag not found (GUID: f8ddf5).", {1, 0, 0})
        return
    end

    -- Extract the token object from the bag
    local tokenTemplate = tokenBag.takeObject({guid = "7a8aba"})
    if not tokenTemplate then
        broadcastToAll("Error: Token template (GUID: 7a8aba) not found in bag.", {1, 0, 0})
        return
    end

    -- Clean up the extracted template
    tokenTemplate.destruct()
end

    printToAll("Deleting unnecessary things.\nPLEASE WAIT..", "Yellow")
    local pos={}
    for i, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        pos=obj.getPosition()
        if ((pos.y > -8 and pos.y < 0.36) or pos.y > 0.71) and not obj.getVar("keepForTerrainEditor") then
            obj.destroy()
        end
    end
    Global.setVectorLines({})
    printToAll("DONE!", "Yellow")
end

function isValidDeployMode(mode)
    return mode == "colosseum" or mode == "combatPatrol" or mode == "incursion" or mode == "strikeForce" or mode == "boardingAction" or mode == "edition11"
end

function setDeployZonesForSize(preserveSelected)
    -- Use Strike Force data if we have an invalid mapSizeSelected
    local sizeEntry = sizeData[mapSizeSelected] or sizeData[4]
    local sizeId = sizeEntry.id
    if sizeId == 1 then
        setDeployZonesMode("colosseum", preserveSelected)
    elseif sizeId == 2 then
        setDeployZonesMode("combatPatrol", preserveSelected)
    elseif sizeId == 3 then
        setDeployZonesMode("incursion", preserveSelected)
    elseif sizeId == 4 or sizeId == 5 then
        -- Standard (Strike Force) games use the 11th edition deployments.
        setDeployZonesMode("edition11", preserveSelected)
    elseif sizeId == 6 then
        setDeployZonesMode("boardingAction", preserveSelected)
    else
        -- Default to the 11th edition deployments here as well.
        setDeployZonesMode("edition11", preserveSelected)
    end
end

function setDeployZonesMode(mode, preserveSelected)
    local byMode = {
        colosseum = DeployZonesColosseum,
        combatPatrol = DeployZonesCombatPatrol,
        incursion = DeployZonesIncursion,
        strikeForce = DeployZonesStrikeForce,
        boardingAction = DeployZonesBoardingAction,
        edition11 = DeployZonesEdition11,
    }
    deployMode = mode
    DeployZonesData = byMode[mode] or DeployZonesDefault
    if preserveSelected and deploySelected and DeployZonesData[deploySelected] then
        return
    end
    deploySelected = #DeployZonesData
end

function createButtonWithBorder(buttonParams, _borderColor)
    self.createButton(buttonParams)
end

function normalizeDispositionIndex(index)
    if index > #dispositionValues then
        return 1
    end
    if index < 1 then
        return #dispositionValues
    end
    return index
end

function getDispositionButtonColor(selectedValue)
    return dispositionButtonColors[selectedValue] or {1, 1, 1}
end

function createDispositionSelector(label, selectedIndex, centerWorldZ, downFunction, upFunction, locked)
    local selectedValue = dispositionValues[selectedIndex] or dispositionValues[1]
    local selectedColor = getDispositionButtonColor(selectedValue)
    local worldX = locked and ingameDispositionControlWorldX or dispositionControlWorldX
    local worldZ = centerWorldZ
    if locked and label == "Blue Disposition" then
        worldZ = ingameBlueDispositionControlWorldZ
    elseif locked and label == "Red Disposition" then
        worldZ = ingameRedDispositionControlWorldZ
    end
    local buttonHeight = locked and ingameDispositionButtonHeight or dispositionButtonHeight
    local buttonWidth = locked and ingameDispositionButtonWidth or dispositionButtonWidth
    local buttonFontSize = locked and ingameDispositionButtonFontSize or dispositionButtonFontSize
    local worldY = locked and ingameDispositionControlWorldY or dispositionControlWorldY
    local center = self.positionToLocal({worldX, worldY, worldZ})
    local cx, cy, cz = center.x, center.y, center.z
    local dispositionButton = {
        label = selectedValue, click_function = "none", function_owner = self,
        position = {cx, cy, cz}, rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = buttonHeight, width = buttonWidth, font_size = buttonFontSize,
        color = selectedColor, font_color = {0, 0, 0}, tooltip = label,
    }
    createButtonWithBorder(dispositionButton)

    if locked then
        return
    end

    self.createButton({
        label = "->", click_function = upFunction, function_owner = self,
        position = {cx + dispositionArrowOffset, cy, cz}, rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = dispositionArrowHeight, width = dispositionArrowWidth, font_size = dispositionArrowFontSize,
        color = {0, 0, 0}, font_color = {1, 1, 1}, tooltip = "Next " .. label,
    })
    self.createButton({
        label = "<-", click_function = downFunction, function_owner = self,
        position = {cx - dispositionArrowOffset, cy, cz}, rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = dispositionArrowHeight, width = dispositionArrowWidth, font_size = dispositionArrowFontSize,
        color = {0, 0, 0}, font_color = {1, 1, 1}, tooltip = "Previous " .. label,
    })
end

function writeDispositionMenu(locked)
    blueDispositionSelected = normalizeDispositionIndex(blueDispositionSelected)
    redDispositionSelected = normalizeDispositionIndex(redDispositionSelected)
    createDispositionSelector("Blue Disposition", blueDispositionSelected, blueDispositionControlWorldZ, "blueDispositionDown", "blueDispositionUp", locked)
    createDispositionSelector("Red Disposition", redDispositionSelected, redDispositionControlWorldZ, "redDispositionDown", "redDispositionUp", locked)

    if not locked then
        writeGenerateMissionButton()
    end
end

function updateDispositionSelection(color, add)
    if color == "Blue" then
        blueDispositionSelected = normalizeDispositionIndex(blueDispositionSelected + add)
    elseif color == "Red" then
        redDispositionSelected = normalizeDispositionIndex(redDispositionSelected + add)
    end
    writeMenus()
end

function blueDispositionUp()
    updateDispositionSelection("Blue", 1)
end

function blueDispositionDown()
    updateDispositionSelection("Blue", -1)
end

function redDispositionUp()
    updateDispositionSelection("Red", 1)
end

function redDispositionDown()
    updateDispositionSelection("Red", -1)
end

function writeGenerateMissionButton()
    local center = self.positionToLocal({generateMissionWorldX, generateMissionWorldY, generateMissionWorldZ})
    local missionReady = gameMode == "game" and packSelected ~= nil
    createButtonWithBorder({
        label = "Generate Missions & Layouts", click_function = missionReady and "generateMission" or "none", function_owner = self,
        position = {center.x, center.y, center.z}, rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = dispositionButtonHeight, width = 4500, font_size = 350,
        color = {0.191999942, 0.701, 0.167999923}, font_color = {0, 0, 0},
        tooltip = "Deal each player's primary mission for the current dispositions",
    }, {0, 0, 0, 1})
    writeDeploymentRandomPickButton()
end

function writeDeploymentRandomPickButton()
    local btn = self.positionToLocal({deploymentRandomPickButtonWorldX, deploymentRandomPickButtonWorldY, deploymentRandomPickButtonWorldZ})

        label = "Random Single Layout", click_function = "randomMission", function_owner = self,
        position = {btn.x, btn.y, btn.z}, rotation = {0, 0, 0},
        height = dispositionButtonHeight, width = 4500, font_size = 340,
